recipes.title: A Nice Cup of Tea
recipes.description: A nice cup of tea is the usual answer in Britain and Ireland to any everyday problem. Nothing is so bad that a nice cup of tea with a friend or family member can't make it better.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 3–5 measures of loose tea leaves or 3–5 tea bags
Sweetener, such as sugar or honey, to taste
Milk or lemon juice to taste

steps.text: Pour freshly-drawn water into a tea kettle, and heat it to your desired temperature. An electric kettle is fast and convenient.

Pour some hot tap water into your teapot and let stand for about several seconds to a minute to pre-warm it. Alternately, you can swish some of the hotter boiling water from your kettle around in the teapot for a few seconds. Pour out this water before adding the tea to the teapot.
If using loose tea, place it into an infuser, then into the teapot. If using teabags, place them into the teapot.

When the water reaches the preferred temperature, pour it from the tea kettle into the teapot. As you pour, try to avoid pouring directly onto the tea (especially important for green and white teas) to avoid scalding the leaves.

Allow the tea to infuse quietly (i.e. do not stir the teapot or "dunk the teabag"). Agitating the tea releases more of the bitter compounds and degrades the taste. Watch the time to avoid over-infusion, and remove the infuser or tea bag when the time is up.
Pour tea into your cup(s). Add sweetener and milk or lemon to taste.

recipes.notes: You can also prepare a single cup of tea at once by placing a single measure of tea directly into the serving cup. Commonly one-half to one tea measure (or rounded teaspoon if you do not have a tea measure) is added per desired cup of tea. Some people add an extra measure "for the pot" (e.g., if 4 cups of tea are desired, 5 measures of tea would be used. It really is a matter of personal preference.) Remember that the tannins in tea stain, so it is advisable to pour the tea over a non-staining surface, wipe up any spills quickly, and not leave tea standing in a teapot for long periods of time. Never combine milk and lemon in the same cup of tea or the milk will curdle into lumps. If you are using an infuser, be sure it is closed tightly so the tea does not spill into the pot. Rinse the tea-filled infuser briefly under cool tap water to wash away tiny flakes that would otherwise drift int (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Acorn Crusted Salmon
recipes.description: You can use any type of salmon for this dish. Typical seasons are June/July for Sockeye Salmon, July-November for Coho Salmon, and August/September for Chinook Salmon.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Use a food processor, blender or other method (meat tenderizer, etc.) to pulverize the acorns into a fine meal. If desired, toast the acorn meal for 5-7 minutes at 375°F/190°C/gas mark 5. Transfer the acorn meal to a dish.
Place the egg whites in a shallow dish. Coat each salmon fillet in egg white.
Coat each fillet with the acorn meal.
Oven cooking method: Transfer coated fillets to a slightly greased or non-stick baking sheet.
Bake for 10-15 minutes in a 425°F/220°C/gas mark 7 oven, or until the fish is flaky when pulled apart with a fork.
Serve.
Stovetop cooking method: Heat a few tablespoons of oil in in a frying pan over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, add the coated salmon fillets.
Pan fry the salmon for 2–3 minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the fillet, until fish is flaky when pulled apart with a fork.
Serve.

recipes.notes: Serve over brown rice and/or add steamed vegetables and roasted potatoes to complete the plate. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Agedashi Tofu
recipes.description: Agedashi tofu (or agedashi dofu) 揚げ出し豆腐 is a simple Japanese way to serve hot tofu. Silken (kinugoshi) firm tofu, cut into cubes, is lightly dusted with potato starch or cornstarch and then deep fried until golden brown. It's then served in a hot tentsuyu broth made of dashi, mirin, and shoyu (Japanese soy sauce), and topped with finely chopped green onions or grated daikon. It is eaten with chopsticks.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Cut the soft tofu into rectangular pieces about 1 inch thick.
Arrange the layers on rack with paper towels and leave for 10–15 minutes to drain. Change the paper and turn over the slices.
In pan, mix sauce ingredients, and heat in a pan until boiling. Turn off the heat.
Sprinkle starch on a plate. Arrange the tofu slices on it. Sprinkle more starch over the tofu.
Heat the oil to 355°F (180°C) for deep frying.
Pat any excess starch off the tofu slices and slide them into the hot oil, one by one. Don't add too many slices at once, because the tofu lowers the oil temperature. Fry until golden, turning once.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
Arrange the tofu in a dish, and pour the sauce over top. Top with a mound of grated daikon (radish), a bit of grated ginger, and sliced green onions.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Megwoo at English Wikibooks / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Agedashi.jpg

recipes.title: Agua de Jamaica
recipes.description: A ruby-red, tart-sweet hibiscus flower cooler that's one of Mexico's most beloved aguas frescas.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup dried hibiscus flowers (flor de jamaica)

steps.text: Rinse the hibiscus flowers briefly in a strainer to remove any dust.
Bring 4 cups of the water to a boil in a saucepan, add the flowers, and boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat, stir in the sugar until dissolved, and steep for 15 minutes.
Strain into a large pitcher, pressing on the flowers, and discard them.
Add the remaining 4 cups cold water and the lime juice, then taste and adjust sweetness.
Chill thoroughly and serve over ice.

recipes.photoCredit: Emna Mizouni / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hibiscus_tea.jpg

recipes.title: Akutaq (Yup'ik Berry Whip)
recipes.description: A whipped Alaskan dessert of fat and wild berries made by Yup'ik and Iñupiat families; this home version uses vegetable shortening, a common modern substitute.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable shortening (or rendered caribou or moose fat, traditionally)
1/4 cup cold water or seal oil
3 cups mixed berries (cloudberries, salmonberries, blueberries, or cranberries)

steps.text: Place the shortening in a large bowl.
Beat by hand or with a mixer, adding the cold water a little at a time, until light, white, and fluffy, about 5 minutes.
Beat in the sugar until dissolved.
Gently fold in the berries until evenly mixed.
Spoon into a serving bowl and chill for 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.photoCredit: Matyáš Havel / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Iced_Akutaq.jpg

recipes.title: Alabama White Sauce
recipes.description: Alabama white sauce is a variety of mayonnaise-based white barbecue sauce. Its origin is frequently traced to Robert Gibson of Big Bob Gibson’s Bar-B-Q restaurant in Alabama. The sauce can be brushed on meat or used as a dipping sauce.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Place all ingredients in a very large blender or food processor. Blend for 1 minute, or until thoroughly combined and mixture is smooth. Pour sauce into a large bowl.

Use when grilling chicken or other poultry or meat; brush lightly over the chicken (or meat) during the last few minutes of grilling. This sauce is also great for dipping; set some sauce aside for passing at the table.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Aloo Paratha (Potato-Stuffed Flatbread)
recipes.description: Whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with a spiced potato filling and griddle-cooked with ghee until golden and flaky, a classic Punjabi breakfast served with yogurt and pickle.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups whole wheat flour (atta), plus more for dusting
1 cup warm water, or as needed
1 tsp amchur (dry mango powder) or 1 tbsp lemon juice

steps.text: Mix the flour and salt in a large bowl, add the oil, and gradually stir in the warm water until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 to 7 minutes until smooth and pliable, then cover it and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 to 25 minutes until completely tender, then drain, peel, and let them cool.
Mash the potatoes until smooth with no lumps, then mix in the onion, chiles, ginger, cilantro, cumin, garam masala, amchur, chile powder, and salt.
Divide the dough into 6 equal balls and the filling into 6 equal portions.
Roll a dough ball into a 4-inch (10 cm) circle, place a portion of filling in the center, and gather the edges up over the filling, pinching to seal.
Flatten the stuffed ball gently, dust with flour, and carefully roll it into a 7-inch (18 cm) round, pressing lightly so the filling does not break through.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or tawa over medium-high heat and place a paratha on the dry pan; cook for about 1 minute until small bubbles appear, then flip.
Brush the top with ghee, flip again, and brush the second side; press with a spatula and cook until both sides are golden brown with crisp spots, 2 to 3 minutes total.
Repeat with the remaining parathas, keeping the cooked ones warm wrapped in a clean towel.
Serve hot with a pat of butter, plain yogurt, and Indian pickle.

recipes.title: Ambrosia Fruit Salad
recipes.description: Ambrosia Fruit Salad is a sweet mixture of mandarin oranges, fruit cocktail, coconut, and marshmallows coated in whipped cream. It originated in the 1900s and had a period of popularity in the United States. It is widely considered to be a traditional dish, suitable for family gatherings.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Mix the mandarin oranges, pineapple, and grapes in a large bowl.
Fold in the whipped cream, sour cream, and marshmallows.
Chill for at least an hour.
Stir again before serving.

recipes.photoCredit: Marshall Astor / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ambrosia_salad.jpg

recipes.title: American Potato Salad I
recipes.description: Potato salad is able to trace its origins to Germany before the turn of the 17th century, where it first became popular to use vinegar and spices on the potato as a side to a meal. The salad has a bite to it and is served warm as often as not.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Peel and cut potatoes into 3/4 inch cubes.
Cover potatoes with an inch of water in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add 1 tablespoon salt to boiling water and reduce heat to medium.
Simmer about 8 minutes, stirring gently once or twice, until potatoes are tender. Taste a piece—don't overcook.
Drain potatoes and place in a large bowl.
Toss potatoes gently with vinegar using a rubber spatula.
Cool potatoes. They must be no more than barely warm to mix.
Chop celery fine.
Stir together celery, celery seeds, mayonnaise, dry mustard, onion, parsley, pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Gently fold together dressing mix and potatoes.
Cover and refrigerate at least an hour, until thoroughly chilled.

recipes.notes: You may have to substitute celery salt for the celery seeds, but then leave out the salt in the dressing. Do not mix too much once the potatoes are in, or they will break down. A couple of hard-boiled eggs, diced about 1/4 inch may be added when the final mix is made. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Angels on Horseback (Bacon-wrapped Oysters)
recipes.description: Angels on horseback are oysters wrapped in bacon strips and broiled.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Mix the wine, garlic, salt, and pepper together. Add the oysters and marinate 10 to 20 minutes.
Preheat the broiler.
Cut each bacon slice in half and wrap each oyster with a piece of bacon, securing with a toothpick.
Broil on both sides until the bacon is crisp. You may also cook them on an outdoor or rangetop grill.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Apfelstrudel (Apple Strudel)
recipes.description: Paper-thin layers of buttery pastry wrapped around cinnamon apples, raisins and toasted breadcrumbs, dusted with powdered sugar.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb tart apples (such as Granny Smith), peeled, cored and thinly sliced
1/3 cup raisins, soaked in 2 tbsp rum or warm water

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toast the breadcrumbs in 2 tablespoons of the melted butter in a skillet over medium heat until golden, then set aside.
Toss the apples with the sugar, drained raisins, nuts, cinnamon and lemon juice in a large bowl.
Lay one sheet of phyllo on a clean kitchen towel, brush it with butter, and repeat with the remaining sheets, stacking them.
Sprinkle the toasted breadcrumbs over the lower two thirds of the stack, leaving a 2-inch border on the sides.
Spread the apple filling over the breadcrumbs, fold in the sides, and use the towel to help roll the pastry up into a tight log.
Transfer the strudel seam side down to the baking sheet and brush it generously with the remaining butter.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until deep golden brown, then let cool for 15 minutes.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve warm with vanilla sauce, whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Appam (Fermented Rice Pancake)
recipes.description: Appam, a fermented rice pancake, is a speciality of the South Indian coastal state of Kerala. It is especially popular among the Christian communities of that state. Appam are often served along with a coconut-flavoured vegetable stew. It is also very popular in Sri Lanka, where it is known as "appa" (or "hopper") and often served with an added egg.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: water for soaking rice, and 2 to 2 1/2 cups for grinding
1/2 teaspoon yeast or kefir, to start the ferment (optional)

steps.text: Soak the raw rice in water.
Grind the soaked rice until about 1/4 ground.
Add the grated coconut along with a little water and continue grinding.
Add the sugar, cooked rice and yeast or kefir, and keep grinding until the whole mixture becomes smooth. It should be thinner than pancake batter.
Transfer it to a wide open container and leave it to rise overnight.
The next morning, add salt and refrigerate the batter until use.
To fry the appams, use a tava or a small bowl-shaped pan with either a non-stick coating or a little oil (coconut or any other refined oil) or ghee.
Pour a full serving spoon of batter into the middle of the pan and swirl it around a single time so that a little of the batter sticks to the sides.
Cover the pan with a hot lid and remove the appam with a spatula after 2–3 minutes, when it becomes slightly browned around the edges. It should be round, with a thick centre and thin, lacy edges.

recipes.notes: The batter should ferment overnight without any added starter, but often won't. Yeast (or better still, kefir) can be added to help it ferment. The grinding can be done in a blender. Make sure that there is enough liquid so that it all swirls around in the blender, mixing properly. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: KARTY JazZ / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Appam_served_with_Coconut_Milk_in_Tamil_Nadu.JPG

recipes.title: Apple and Blackberry Crumble
recipes.description: Late-summer apples and wild blackberries baked under a buttery oat crumble, served with custard or cream.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb cooking apples, peeled, cored, and sliced

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Toss the apples and blackberries with the sugar and lemon juice and spread them in a 2-quart baking dish.
Mix the flour, oats, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until the mixture forms coarse clumps.
Scatter the crumble evenly over the fruit without pressing it down.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the topping is golden and the fruit juices bubble up at the edges.
Let stand for 10 minutes and serve warm with custard, cream, or vanilla ice cream.

recipes.photoCredit: Suzette - www.suzette.nu from Arnhem, Netherlands / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vegan_apple_crumble_(8293111737).jpg

recipes.title: Apple Crisp I
recipes.description: Apple crisp is a dessert made up of a baked apple filling and a crispy crumb topping. It is similar to cobbler, which has a biscuit-like (USA biscuit that is) or cake-like topping. It is also similar to a crumble, and the terms 'crisp' and 'crumble' may occasionally be used interchangeably.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 6 cups sliced and cored baking apples (for example, Granny Smith)
1/3 cup (75 g) cold butter or cold margarine

steps.text: In a medium bowl stir together flour, brown sugar, and oatmeal. If the room temperature is a bit warm, you should cool this mixture in the fridge.

Prepare the apples. This should be completed before mixing butter into the topping. It is helpful to choose apples that do not brown quickly; Granny Smith apples are a good choice. Do not use Red Delicious apples; they turn to mush. Place the apples into a 9-inch (23 cm) square baking dish; glass is best.

Add the butter or margarine to the topping. Mix it via a slicing action, so that the butter or margarine forms tiny little chunks and does not melt or smear. A pair of butter knives, used like scissors, is good for this. You must work quickly once you start this step.
Sprinkle the topping onto the apples. You may pat it down just a bit.

Bake for about 30 minutes in a 375 °F (190°C) oven. Do not remove the crisp before the top is dark brown. Black spots indicate burning. It is better to burn a few small spots, which you can then remove, than to risk undercooking the topping.

recipes.notes: Any type of apple may be used, baking or sweet, or a mixture of types. Cooked apple dishes are a good use for substandard apples, e.g. damaged, wrinkled & windfall. Crisps can be made with most any sort of fruit. Pineapple is a good choice. Some fruits, especially peaches, go better in a cobbler. Raisins can be added to the apples at the beginning, and 1/2 teaspoon of powdered ginger, or a sprinkling of nutmeg can also be put in. Mixed spice is a perfect addition to apple dishes. This is more popular in Britain than the US. (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Disposable12345 assumed (based on copyright / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Apple-crisp.jpg

recipes.title: Arroz con Leche
recipes.description: Creamy Mexican rice pudding perfumed with cinnamon and lime peel, enjoyed warm or chilled.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Rinse the rice in cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Combine the rice, water, cinnamon stick, and lime peel in a heavy saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 10 minutes until most of the water is absorbed.
Stir in the milk, evaporated milk, sugar, and salt.
Simmer over low heat, stirring frequently, for 25–30 minutes until the rice is very tender and the pudding is creamy.
Remove the cinnamon stick and lime peel and stir in the vanilla and raisins.
Serve warm or chilled, dusted with ground cinnamon.

recipes.title: Au Jus Sandwich
recipes.description: The au jus sandwich is also known as roast beef au jus, and is better known in America as the french dip sandwich. It traces its origins to downtown Los Angeles in either 1908 or 1918, when a local restaurant owner was making a sandwich for a police officer and accidentally dropped it into a pan of beef broth.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2–3 lb roast or other cut of beef
1 can (~2 cups / 16 oz / 470 ml) beef consommé, bouillon cube equivalent, or additional roast beef
1 can (~2 cups / 16 oz / 470 ml) French onion soup

steps.text: Combine all the ingredients except the rolls in a slow cooker or crock pot. Let the mixture simmer for at least six hours. This step is critical because it makes the meat tender.
Serve beef on split rolls.

You can either pre-dip the sandwich, or serve with a bowl of meat drippings. When serving the drippings separately, remove the beef shreds from the juices and serve with a small bowl of meat drippings on the side. Dip the sandwiches in the drippings as you eat.

recipes.notes: Bread can be toasted and buttered before adding beef. In the original sandwich, the bread was dipped in the juice prior to adding the meat, rather than dipped at the table. Other meats can be substituted, including lamb, pork, and turkey. Try adding cheese, horseradish, or mustard to the sandwich. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Baby Back Ribs
recipes.description: There are two methods here: the traditional smoking, and the oven smoking method. Both of them produce mouthwatering, fall-off-the-bone ribs.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 slabs baby back pork ribs (also known as back ribs, loin ribs, back loin ribs)
1/4 cup paprika (if you're doing the oven method, use smoked paprika)
Several pounds each hickory and applewood chunks, or chips if using oven method

steps.text: Prep: Combine 1/4 cup of the brown sugar, chili powder, garlic powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. Rub meat side of ribs with this mixture and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine remaining ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until reduced by half. Set aside.
Oven procedure: Place a 1/4 cup each hickory and applewood chunks in the bottom of a roasting pan. Place a rack in the pan and place ribs on the rack.
Cover roasting pan with aluminum foil and place in the center of a 200°F oven and cook 6 hours, brushing with sauce every hour.
Take ribs and remove foil. Brush meat side liberally with sauce and place under a preheated broiler until well browned.
Slice into 1-rib portions and serve warm with remaining sauce.
Traditional procedure: Place enough hickory and applewood into the firebox of your friendly neighborhood smoker to keep the temperature around 200°F.
Place ribs in smoker and cook 6 hours, brushing with sauce every hour.
Brush meat side liberally with sauce and place meat side down on a high grill until well browned.
Remove, slice into 1-rib portions, and serve with remaining sauce.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: The Pancake of Heaven! / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Baby_back_ribs_with_fries.jpg

recipes.title: Backyard BBQ Chicken
recipes.description: BBQ chicken is always a barbecue favorite.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts and drumsticks

steps.text: Combine dry ingredients and rub onto chicken.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Combine liquid ingredients, bring to a boil, and simmer until reduced by 1/3.
Place on medium grill, and turn often, brushing with sauce when turned until interior temperature reaches 165°F.
Let rest for 10 minutes; serve.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Bacon and Cabbage with Parsley Sauce
recipes.description: Ireland's quintessential Sunday dinner: a boiled bacon joint served with tender cabbage, floury potatoes, and a creamy parsley sauce.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3 lb boneless smoked pork shoulder or bacon joint (collar or loin)
1 head green cabbage, cored and cut into wedges
1/2 cup cooking liquid from the bacon

steps.text: Place the bacon joint in a large pot, cover with cold water, bring to a boil, then drain and discard the water to remove excess salt.
Return the joint to the pot with the onion, bay leaf, and peppercorns, cover with fresh cold water, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Simmer, partly covered, for about 20 minutes per pound (roughly 1 hour), until a skewer slides easily into the meat.
Meanwhile, boil the potatoes in their skins in salted water for 20 to 25 minutes until tender, then drain and keep warm.
Lift the cooked bacon onto a board, cover loosely with foil, and let it rest for 15 minutes; reserve the cooking liquid.
Bring the bacon cooking liquid back to a boil, add the cabbage wedges, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until just tender.
Drain the cabbage well and toss it with 2 tablespoons butter and plenty of black pepper.
For the sauce, melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour, and cook for 1 minute without browning.
Gradually whisk in the milk and 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid, then simmer, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes until smooth and thickened.
Stir in the parsley and pepper, taste, and add salt only if needed, since the bacon liquid is salty.
Slice the bacon thickly and serve with the cabbage, potatoes, and parsley sauce spooned over.

recipes.title: Baingan Bartha (South Indian Eggplant with Coconut and Chili) I
recipes.description: Baingan bartha is an eggplant (aubergine) dish much loved all over India. This southern version of the dish is very different from northern varieties, and well suited to the cuisine of the region.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Roast the eggplant directly over a low flame. Don't be afraid to set it right on the gas burner, turning it regularly until the skin becomes blackened and brittle and the flesh soft (about 15–20 minutes).
Set aside to cool.
Grind the chillies, coconut, and coriander together in a food processor to form a paste.
Peel the eggplant skin off and mash the flesh to a uniform pulp by hand.
Mix in the coconut paste and paneer/yogurt, along with salt to taste.
Serve with chapatis, dosa or rice.

recipes.notes: Baingan bartha is commonly produced with coriander (seeds) and/or cilantro (leaves, from the same plant, and thus sometimes confusingly called coriander as well). (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Baked Beans
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 pounds (900 g) Navy, Great Northern, or Pea beans, though black, kidney, or lima beans may be used for a different taste.

steps.text: Soak dry beans overnight, or use 4 cans cooked beans.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Stir all ingredients together, then pour into casserole dish, bean pot or Dutch oven.
Add water from beans, or preferably stock or fresh water. Just enough to barely cover. Canned beans may need less water. Beans will absorb more water as they cook.
Bake 2 1/2 hours. Check after an hour for moisture level, add more water as needed to keep appropriate moistness. If beans have too much liquid, remove lid and cook a bit longer.

recipes.notes: A slow cooker may be used: cook 2 1/2 hours on High, or 5 hours on Low. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
recipes.description: Baked ziti is a type of casserole in Italian-American cuisine. It consists primarily of pasta and various cheeses in a tomato-based sauce.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ziti or other pasta

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425 °F (225 °C). Coat a large baking dish with olive oil.
Mix ricotta, egg, basil, oregano, parsley and about half of the mozzarella and Parmesan in a large bowl until well incorporated. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook ziti in a large pot of salted water until al dente. Drain well.

In a large bowl or pot, toss ziti with marinara sauce and red pepper flakes until noodles are covered. Stir in ricotta mixture and fold until it begins to melt. Pour mixture into greased dish and spread it out with a spoon.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top, then sprinkle bread crumbs over cheese.
Bake at 425 °F (225 °C) for 20 minutes or until cheese on top turns golden and begins to bubble.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Lili from NY, United States / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Baked_Ziti.jpg

recipes.title: Banana Nut Muffins
recipes.description: A recipe for banana nut muffins, based on one from the Joy of Cooking, but slightly modified.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1/2 cups (120 ml) chopped nuts (such as walnuts)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Grease a muffin tin.
Cream together eggs, honey, milk, vegetable oil, and bananas.
Combine dry ingredients, then mix gently with wet ingredients. Lumpy batter is to be expected.
Bake for 20–25 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.photoCredit: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.5 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Banana-Nut-Muffins-2005-Aug-24.jpg

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 cup + 2 Tablespoons (200 g + 25 g) granulated sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract or vanilla sugar

steps.text: Custard: In a saucepan, stir together the milk, 1 cup (200 g) of sugar, butter, salt, and vanilla extract and cook over medium heat until the butter melts.
Whisk the egg yolks in a separate container (a coffee mug will do), then whisk two tablespoons of the hot milk mixture into the egg yolks to temper them so they don’t curdle.
When the egg mixture is smooth, whisk it into the milk mixture.
Add 2 tablespoons of cold water to the cornstarch and stir until smooth; then whisk it into the milk mixture and cook until thickened, stirring constantly so it doesn’t burn.
Remove the custard from heat.
Meringue: Whip the egg whites and 2 Tablespoons (25 g) sugar in a bowl until stiff peaks form.
Cut the bananas into thin slices (about 1/4 inch or 5 mm thick).
In a large bowl with a flat bottom, place a layer of vanilla wafers or ladyfingers on the bottom.
Pour half of the lemon juice and spread half of the custard over these, then layer half of the banana slices on top of the custard.
Add another layer of cookies, the rest of the lemon juice, the rest of the custard, and the rest of the banana slices.
Top with the meringue and sprinkle the coconut on top.
Refrigerate for several hours before serving.

recipes.notes: If you'd rather make the custard using a custard powder, that's fine, but you won't have leftover egg whites to make the meringue with. In this case, you can replace the meringue with whipped cream.
recipes.photoCredit: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Banana_pudding,_homemade.jpg

recipes.title: Bangers and Mash
recipes.description: You can fry or grill sausages quickly, but in this recipe they are cooked slowly (as recommended by Nigel Slater, no less) so as to really bring out the flavour. Some people like baked beans with their sausage and mash, some people like gravy, and some people don't need either.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2–3 good British butcher's sausages per person
2 medium-to-large potatoes per person (Maris piper potatoes are good.)

steps.text: Bangers: Put a large heavy frying pan on a hob over a medium heat. Put in a little vegetable oil (if desired) and let it warm up.
Then place the sausages in a single layer in the frying pan. Let them fry a minute or so, then turn them over, fry another minute, turn them around again, to try and get a bit of colour all over.

Once they've been in the hot pan for 5 minutes or so, turn the heat right down to low. Let them fry very gently for the next 25 minutes, turning them over every 5 or 10 minutes so they get cooked evenly. You can cook them for longer than this (even up to about an hour on a very low heat). Always make sure the sausages are cooked all the way through (no pinkness should remain).
Mash: Peel the potatoes and chop them roughly into pieces around 1 or 2 cm thick. Add them to a large pan of boiling water and boil vigorously for 15 minutes.
When they're done (they'll be soft enough that you can easily put a knife/fork into one of the pieces), drain them in a colander and return them to the big pan (not on the heat any more).
Add a generous knob of butter and a splash of milk to the potatoes, and mash them all up with a potato masher.

recipes.notes: You do not need to prick the sausages—that only lets tasty juices escape! Similarly you don't necessarily need to separate them one from another until after they've cooked. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Bannock
recipes.description: A simple skillet bread baked across Canada by First Nations and Métis families, made from pantry staples and cooked over a campfire or stovetop.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1/4 cup lard, butter, or vegetable shortening, cut into pieces
1 tbsp vegetable oil, for the pan

steps.text: Whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Rub the lard into the flour with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs.
Pour in the water and stir just until a soft dough forms; do not overmix.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and pat it into a round about 1 inch thick.
Heat the oil in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium-low heat.
Place the dough in the skillet, cover, and cook for 10–12 minutes until the bottom is golden.
Flip the bannock and cook, covered, for another 10–12 minutes until it sounds hollow when tapped.
Cut into wedges and serve warm with butter, jam, or wojapi.

recipes.title: Banoffee Pie
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 9 oz (250 g / 16 ea.) gingernut (or digestive) biscuits
1 tin (400 g / 14 oz) sweetened condensed milk

steps.text: Base: Crush the biscuits into crumbs with the end of a rolling pin. This is best done inside a freezer bag to avoid spillage and loss.
Melt two-fifths of the butter (about 4 oz) in a large saucepan. Once melted, take off the heat and mix in the biscuit crumbs.
Press into the bottom of an 8-inch (20 cm) loose-bottomed pie tin, and transfer to the fridge to chill.

Filling: Place the remaining butter with the sugar into a medium-sized saucepan (ideally non-stick if you don't like dish washing). Melt over a medium heat, stirring until the butter has melted and the sugar is just starting to melt.
Add the condensed milk and bring to the boil, stirring continuously for 5 minutes to make your caramel.
Slice the bananas, arrange over the crumb base, and pour the caramel over the top.
Chill for at least an hour so the caramel firms up.
Prior to serving, whip the cream, and spoon over the top. Optionally, garnish with some grated chocolate or Cape gooseberries.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Glen MacLarty from Sydney, Australia. / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Banoffeepie.jpg

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef Brisket Sandwiches
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1/2 cup vinegar mixture from North Carolina-Style BBQ Ribs, plus more for serving

steps.text: Place mesquite into the firebox of a 250°F smoker.
Trim fat cap to 1/4 inch. Place brisket into a large foil pouch and pour in vinegar mixture, Worcestershire sauce, and honey. Place pouch in smoker and cook for 6 hours, changing chunks as needed.
Remove brisket from pouch, spread mustard evenly on it, and massage Rub into meat. Place brisket back into smoker and cook for 10 hours, changing chunks as needed.
Separate brisket halves along fat line. Slice across the grain as thinly as humanly possible, chop roughly, and place serving portion in halved buns.
Place some vinegar mixture into a squirt bottle and serve with sandwiches.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Willis Lam / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dickey%27s_BBQ_Beef_Brisket_Classic_Sandwich_(28545540178).jpg

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 each chicken thighs, legs, and breasts

steps.text: Combine all brine ingredients in a 2-gallon zip-top bag. Insert chicken and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Combine sauce ingredients and bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced by half.
Quickly swab the grill with an oiled towel tied with twine to lube.
Combine Rub ingredients and massage all over chicken. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.

Grill chicken over a preheated charcoal grill, turning often, for 10 minutes. Cook, turning often and brushing with sauce when turned, until internal temperature reaches 165°F in the breast and 170°F for the dark meat.
Cover with foil and let rest 7 minutes. Meanwhile, boil remaining sauce for 5 minutes and place in a squirt bottle. Serve chicken with sauce on the side.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Barbecue Prime Rib
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 ea. 4-bone standing rib roast, prime grade

steps.text: Coat roast with oil. Shake on seasoning and massage into meat.
Place dry mesquite chunks into firebox of a 250°F smoker.
Insert a probe thermometer into center of roast and set for 118°F.
Place roast into smoker and lower heat to 200°F. Cook until internal temperature is achieved, changing mesquite as needed.
Remove and grill on high heat for 7 minutes or until desired crust is achieved.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Barbecue Ribs
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Massage ribs with the barbecue rub. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Combine remaining ingredients except for hickory in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by 1/2.
Place hickory chunks in firebox of 250°F (120°C) smoker.
Place ribs in smoker and cook, brushing often with tomato mixture and changing the hickory chunks as needed, for 5–6 hours.
Brush ribs generously with mixture and grill on high heat, brushing repeatedly until well-browned on both sides.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce (Kansas City-style)
recipes.description: Barbecue Sauce is a tomato or ketchup based sauce used on meats. Kansas City-style barbecue sauce is the most common version used in the United States. It is tomato- or ketchup- based with sweet, sour and smoky elements. Barbecue sauce can be added to the meat before, during or after cooking.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons (45 mL) finely minced yellow onion
4 teaspoons (20 mL) bottled liquid smoke flavor (hickory)
1/4 teaspoon (1 mL) Louisiana-style red pepper sauce

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Mix well.
Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.notes: This sauce tastes very close to commercial barbecue sauces such as Masterpiece and Bullseye. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Barbecue Wings
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 24 chicken wings, tips removed, cut in half at the joint

steps.text: Combine seasonings and toss with wings. Brush wings on all sides with sauce and refrigerate as long as possible.
Preheat 4 1/2 pounds charcoal in the chimney. Disperse evenly around bottom of grill, then reapply grate.
Add chicken and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove to a plate and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.notes: If you do not know how to use a chimney starter, use a gas grill, or believe the people who sell sickening solvent that they light by being soaked in a chemical, this is how you do it. First, wad up a sheet of newspaper and moisten it with 1–2 tsp vegetable oil. Place it in the bottom compartment, and place your coals in the top compartment. Light, go grab a beer, and wait until the coals are covered with a grey ash, about 15 minutes on good weather. Disperse and cook. (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Barmbrack
recipes.description: A lightly sweet, tea-soaked yeasted fruit bread traditionally baked for Halloween with a ring hidden inside to foretell a wedding.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mixed dried fruit (raisins, sultanas, currants)
1 tsp ground mixed spice (or 1/2 tsp cinnamon plus 1/4 tsp each nutmeg and allspice)

steps.text: Pour the hot tea over the dried fruit and peel in a bowl, cover, and soak for at least 1 hour (or overnight), then drain well, reserving the tea.
Combine the flour, mixed spice, salt, brown sugar, and yeast in a large bowl.
Add the lukewarm milk, melted butter, beaten egg, and 2 tablespoons of the reserved tea, and mix to a soft dough.
Knead on a floured surface for 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Knead in the drained fruit until evenly distributed, adding a little flour if the dough becomes sticky.
Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for about 1 1/2 hours until doubled.
Punch down, shape into a loaf, and place in a greased 9x5-inch loaf pan; if you like, push a foil-wrapped ring into the dough.
Cover and let rise for 30 to 45 minutes until risen just above the rim of the pan, and preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, until deep golden and hollow-sounding when tapped underneath.
Dissolve the sugar in the boiling water, brush over the hot loaf, and return to the oven for 2 minutes to set the glaze.
Cool on a wire rack and serve sliced and buttered, or toasted.

recipes.photoCredit: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barmbrack.jpg

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Tender velveted flank steak and crisp-tender broccoli tossed in a glossy garlic, ginger, and oyster sauce.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
1 tbsp Shaoxing wine or dry sherry

steps.text: Toss the beef with the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, cornstarch, and baking soda and let it marinate for 20 minutes.
Whisk the sauce ingredients together in a small bowl.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 1 minute, then drain well.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Spread the beef in a single layer and sear for 1 minute without moving, then stir-fry for 1 minute until just browned; transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the wok with the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 20 seconds until fragrant.
Add the broccoli and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Return the beef to the wok, stir the sauce, and pour it in.
Toss for 1 to 2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything, then drizzle with sesame oil and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Beef and Guinness Casserole
recipes.description: Here is a recipe for a fantastic beef and Guinness casserole. You can find many variations of this by searching the internet, but I found many of them lacking so I experimented and experimented. Finally it started tasting deep and rich. Serves four (or three if you're my family---they can't get enough!).
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 bottle (500 ml) Guinness or other stout
500 ml (16 oz) of tomato sauce (can use canned chopped tomato, but for a richer sauce use bottles of tomato sauce. Do NOT use ketchup!)
2 cloves of garlic, crushed and sliced thin
2 tablespoons of peppercorns (can add more to taste)

steps.text: Trim the meat of excess fat, and cut into 1-inch pieces.

Cut your vegetables into small, similarly sized pieces. Keep the carrots big enough (about 1/2-inch cuts), and none so big as you wouldn't want to find it later and think "that's a bloody big bit of carrot".

Freshly grind your pepper to a fine powder in a pestle and mortar. Take your time with this. Then add a teaspoon of salt, and set half of this aside for your champ potato. Then add the other half to the 1/4 cup of flour and mix well to get seasoned flour. Then mix this in a big bowl with your beef.

Heat your frying pan over medium-high heat. Add a good lug of olive oil, then add your coated beef (discard the excess coating, which shouldn't be much). You need enough oil so that the coating isn't dry on the beef. You then want to brown the beef—keep it moving so it doesn't burn. What you're doing is sealing the meat so it's tender and undergoing the Mailliard reaction, which give fantastic flavour. Brown in batches if pan is not very large. Put to one side.

Add another small glug of olive oil to the pan. Add the onion and turn to medium-low heat. Cook for a few minutes, add celery and garlic, and continue to cook until they all soften and the onion has started going golden. Add the carrot and continue for another few minutes.

Now get a big oven-proof casserole dish, and add your stock, cooked vegetables, beef, Guinness, tomato, bay leaves and thyme. Bring to boil on a hob, put on the lid, and put into a preheated oven at 150°C (300°F) convection. Check every 40 minutes to 1 hour, and give a good stir. This takes 3 hours to cook properly. All the protein that makes round beef tough comes out into your sauce to make it thick and rich and your beef juicy and tender. If you did the browning part right, the beef should be succulent and bursting with flavour—if not then it is dry and boring.

About 40 minutes before the casserole is done, boil the potatoes until soft. Drain, and allow to steam until dry. Mash thoroughly and add pepper/salt combo (salt to taste), butter, and a little milk—its amazing how little milk will turn your potato to sludge, so be careful. Once all this is mashed well, stir in your spring onion.
Serve in deep bowls. Put a layer of champ at the bottom, ladle your beef and Guinness on the top, serve, and enjoy.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: A Healthier Michigan from Detroit, United States / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Irish_Beef_Stew_(34046928633).jpg

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Kabobs
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds (about 700 g) beef sirloin, cut into 1 1/2 inch (4 cm) cubes
Several assorted bell peppers, cut into 3-inch (7.5 cm) strips
6 bamboo skewers, soaked in water 30 minutes

steps.text: Combine paprika, salt, pepper, cayenne pepper, olive oil, rosemary, thyme and balsamic vinegar in a gallon (4 liter) size zip-top bag. Add beef and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Sort beef cubes into equal size rows. Skewer 1 onion wedge, 1 strip bell pepper, 1 slice zucchini from the side, and 3 cubes of meat across the grain in a pattern per skewer.
Grill over medium high heat, turning often, 11 minutes for medium. Serve warm.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Beef Fajitas
recipes.description: The original contributor of this recipe noted the following anecdote:When I visited San Antonio, Texas, years ago, my cousin took me to the Texas Folklife Festival, where he introduced me to fajitas, telling me that they were originated by poor people who cut "beef skirts" (skirt steak) across the grain to make this tough cut much more tender.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 ea. (2.25 lb / 1 kg) inside skirt steak, cut into 3 equal pieces
2 small red and green bell peppers, sliced

steps.text: Combine olive oil, soy sauce, lime juice, red pepper flakes, cumin, green onion, and brown sugar in a blender. Blend until smooth.
Pour marinade into a gallon size zip-top plastic bag. Add skirt steak and seal, removing as much air as possible. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, preferably 24 hours or more.

Remove steak from marinade and place down as close as possible to coals of a preheated charcoal grill. Cook one side until the internal temperature is 125°F (51°C). Flip and allow to cook until the internal temperature is at least 145°F (63°C) in the thickest part. These temperatures are enough to safely cook the meat, you may like it more well done.

Remove and cover immediately, allowing at least 3 minutes to rest. You may wish to immediately wrap tightly with aluminum foil and remove to a low heat area of the grill or a low heat oven to keep ready for less-than-immediate use.
Meanwhile, place a 9–10-inch (23–25 cm) cast-iron skillet down on the coals (or a stove).

Once pan has heated, toss sliced peppers and onions with vegetable oil. Place in the skillet and cook for at least 2–3 minutes. They should be cooked to a moderately soft state on high heat with some browning evident. A small amount of water can be added, and the pan covered, to partially steam the vegetables if desired. Remove and keep warm.
Slice steak as thinly as possible across the grain.
Serve fajitas with tortillas, salsa, guacamole, and lime wedges (see notes).

recipes.notes: The onion and bell pepper are often mixed with the sliced meat in one dish and allowed to marinate together. The tortillas and other ingredients are typically served on separate dishes. For those who may not know, the eater is expected to assemble the various components of the dish as they prefer—there is no need for the cook to do further assembly. The tortillas are used as wrap for the other ingredients, topped with a squirt of lime juice, if desired. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Beef Heart Kabobs (Anticuchos)
recipes.description: Peruvian anticuchos are a type of grilled skewered meat, often made with beef heart. The dish is one of the most popular in Peru, and it is often sold by street vendors and accompanied by corn-on-the-cob and portions of cold boiled potato with a spot of chili sauce. Those whose tastes do not extend to trying beef heart may substitute any good cut of red meat, though this is not the authentic Peruvian style.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1/4 cup of ground spicy red chili

steps.text: Place all the above ingredients, other than the heart, in a bowl and mix thoroughly.

Clean the heart, removing all fat. Cut into bite-sized cubes. Place the heart pieces into the marinade mixture, and leave to marinate for about 10 hours or overnight. The heart should be completely covered by the marinade.

After marinating, thread the meat onto skewers. If desired, at this stage some additional ingredients such as bell peppers (capsicum) or corn-on-cob (cut to a similar size to the heart) may be also added to the skewers.
Cook the skewers on a barbecue grill, turning frequently while brushing with the marinade mix. When the meat is well done, remove skewers from grill and serve immediately.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Peru_Anticuchos.jpg

recipes.title: Beer Marinated Shrimp
recipes.description: This is an excellent shrimp dish that must be marinated overnight, so if you need dinner half an hour from now this isn't for you.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Combine onion, garlic, shrimp, and beer in a plastic or glass bowl.
Add as much Tabasco as you'd like (start with 1 tbsp) and some salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and marinate overnight.
Remove shrimp from marinade, and discard marinade.
Melt some butter in a pan and sauté shrimp until pink and done. Don't overcook the shrimp or they'll be rubbery. You can also grill the shrimp.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Beer-Braised Bratwurst with Onions
recipes.description: Bratwurst simmered in lager with onions, then browned and served on crusty rolls with mustard — perfect for Oktoberfest.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 bottles (12 oz each) German lager or Märzen beer

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onions for 8 to 10 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Add the beer, caraway and pepper and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the bratwurst, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, turning once, until cooked through to 160°F (71°C).
Remove the sausages and continue simmering the onions until the beer has reduced to a thick glaze.
Meanwhile brown the bratwurst on a hot grill or in a skillet for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until well browned.
Split the rolls, add a bratwurst to each, and top with the beer onions, mustard and sauerkraut.

recipes.title: Bhel Puri (Indian Puffed Rice and Vegetable Snack)
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 packet of flat crispy puris (available in Indian groceries)
2 lb (500 g) puffed rice (kurmura/murmura - available in Indian groceries)
1 lb (125–250 g) plain sev (Indian fried snack, looks like noodles)
Lemon juice or chopped raw mango

steps.text: Mix together puffed rice and sev. Add chat masala, salt, and chili powder.
Add onions, raw mango pieces (or lemon juice), potatoes, and coriander leaves to the puffed rice and sev mixture, and mix gently with the hands.
Grind the items for the spicy and sweet chutneys to a fine paste using some water.
Just before serving, mix in spicy chutney and sweet chutney into the above mixture. Put some mixture in individual plates, then top with some more sev and chutneys (if desired).
Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve with crunchy puris.

recipes.notes: To make date paste, soak dates in hot water for 1/2 hour, grind them, and strain the mixture. (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Barry Pousman from New York, NY / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Behael_Puri_(6105489342).jpg

recipes.title: Bienenstich (Bee Sting Cake)
recipes.description: A soft yeast cake topped with a crunchy honey-almond caramel and filled with vanilla pastry cream.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add the warm milk, egg and softened butter and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Press the dough evenly into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan or 10-inch springform pan, cover and let rise 20 minutes.
For the topping, melt the butter, sugar, honey and cream in a saucepan, simmer for 3 minutes, stir in the almonds and let cool slightly.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C), spread the almond topping over the dough, and bake for 25 to 30 minutes until golden.
For the filling, heat 1 1/2 cups of milk with the sugar, whisk the remaining milk with the cornstarch and yolks, then whisk this into the hot milk and cook until very thick.
Stir the vanilla into the pastry cream, cover the surface with plastic wrap and chill completely.
Cool the cake, then split it horizontally into two layers, cutting the top layer into 12 pieces.
Fold the whipped cream into the cold pastry cream, spread it over the bottom layer, set the topping pieces on top and chill for 1 hour before serving.

recipes.photoCredit: Alice Wiegand / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bienenstich_140531_AW.jpg

recipes.title: Birria de Res
recipes.description: Jalisco-style beef slow-braised in an adobo of dried chiles and warm spices, served as a rich stew or with its consommé for dipping tacos.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 4 lb beef chuck roast and bone-in short ribs, cut into large chunks
6 dried guajillo chiles, stemmed and seeded
3 dried ancho chiles, stemmed and seeded

steps.text: Season the beef all over with the salt.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 3 minutes per side; set aside.
Toast the dried chiles in a dry skillet for 20 seconds per side and simmer them with the tomatoes, onion, and garlic in water for 10 minutes until soft.
Drain and blend the chiles and vegetables with the vinegar, oregano, cumin, cinnamon, cloves, pepper, and 1 cup broth until smooth, then strain.
Return the beef to the pot, pour the adobo over it, and add the bay leaves and remaining broth.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook over low heat (or in a 325°F / 165°C oven) for 3 to 3 1/2 hours until the beef is fork-tender.
Remove the beef, shred it, and discard the bones; skim the fat from the broth and season the consommé with salt.
Serve the beef in bowls with consommé, or dip tortillas in the fat, fill with beef, and griddle until crisp for quesatacos-style tacos.
Garnish with onion, cilantro, and lime, with a cup of hot consommé on the side.

recipes.title: Biscuits and Gravy
recipes.description: Biscuits and gravy is a dish enjoyed nearly everywhere in the United States, though it is most commonly associated with the southern states. It is a staple breakfast of most US diners.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Biscuits: Make 'cut' biscuit dough.
Place the cut biscuits in the oven when you add the bacon grease to the skillet in the gravy procedure below (step 3).
Remove from oven after 10 to 12 minutes; the biscuits should be warm when served with the gravy.
Gravy: Brown the sausage in a large skillet.
Remove the browned sausage from the skillet and reserve in a bowl, being careful to leave as much of the drippings as possible in the pan.
Add the bacon grease to the skillet, and place the skillet on low to medium-low heat.
Once the bacon grease is up to temperature, mix the flour into the grease.
Add the milk slowly, mixing as you pour.
Bring to a gentle boil, stirring constantly scraping the bottom and edges of the skillet. Stirring keeps the gravy from becoming too lumpy or burnt.
Continue stirring until the gravy has nearly reached the desired consistency, usually about 10 minutes.
Add the browned sausage held in reserve.
Remove from heat and allow to set for 1 minute.
Serve with biscuits.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Willis Lam / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Whole_Foods_Biscuits_and_Gravy_(24548241224).jpg

recipes.title: Bizcochito (Cinnamon Anise Cookies) I
recipes.description: A bizcochito or biscochito is a crispy cookie flavored with anise and cinnamon. It was developed by Hispanic residents of New Mexico and southern Colorado who trace their ancestry back to the first Spanish colonists. The recipe for making the cookie has been influenced not only by local and indigenous customs, but also by cookie recipes brought to New Mexico with immigrants from other countries.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Cream the lard, sugar, and anise in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and beat well.
Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Alternately add flour to creamed mixture until a stiff dough has formed.
Knead dough slightly. Pat 1/4–1/2 inch (0.5–1 cm) thick or roll to a 1/4–1/2 inch (0.5–1 cm) diameter log.
Cut into desired shapes.
Bake in an oven preheated to 350°F (180°C) for 10–12 minutes or until golden brown.
Dust, while still hot, with cinnamon sugar.
Let cool.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: John Phelan / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fresh_batch_of_Biscochitos,_Albuquerque_NM.jpg

recipes.title: Black Bean Soup with Tomato-Tomatillo Salsa
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 cup peeled, seeded, and chopped tomato (fresh or canned)
1 small sprig fresh or dried epazote (optional)
1 tablespoon finely-chopped canned chipotle chile (or 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper or to taste)
3 medium tomatillos, husks removed and finely diced
1 small red onion, very finely diced
1 serrano or jalapeño chile, very finely diced
Crème fraîche or sour cream, for garnish

steps.text: Soup: Pick over the beans to remove any debris. Soak if desired and drain.
In a deep, heavy-based pot, heat oil over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add beans, garlic and water.
Bring to a boil, skimming any foam that rises to the surface.
Reduce to a simmer and when the beans are soft, after about 1 hour, add tomato, epazote, chipotle chile, cumin, coriander and salt.
Cook until the beans start to break down and broth begins to thicken.
Taste for seasoning; add salt and pepper if needed.
Salsa: In a small bowl, combine tomato, tomatillo, onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
Taste for seasoning and add salt as needed.
Serving: Ladle soup into individual serving bowls.
Garnish each with a spoonful of crème fraîche and salsa.

recipes.notes: If you're serving this soup immediately, you can thicken it by pureeing a cup or two of the beans in a blender or food processor and then recombining them with the rest of the soup. If refrigerated overnight, the soup will thicken on its own. The salsa will taste best if assembled no more than an hour before serving. Epazote is an herb that looks like a weed and is regularly used in Mexican cooking. If you can't find it, use an equal amount of cilantro. Tomatillos look like rock hard tomatoes with papery skin. Look for them canned in the Hispanic section of your market, if you can't find fresh. They will be perfectly acceptable. Crème fraîche is similar to sour cream, but richer. Look for it in the fancy cheese section. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Black Forest Cake
recipes.description: Black Forest Cake, sometimes called by the French gateau, gateaux or gâteau (meaning "cake"), is a chocolate cake with a strong cherry element. The recipe originates from Germany, where it is called Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: a few drops of vanilla essence

steps.text: Cake: Cream the butter and sugar together well.
Melt the chocolate and beat into the creamed mixture, then beat in the eggs.
Sift flour, salt and cinnamon together.
Fold the dry mix lightly into the liquids, then fold in the sour cream and cold coffee.
Pour the mixture into a lined and greased 9-inch round, deep cake tin, and bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes.
Set to cool on a wire rack.
Pastry base: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl and bind until the mixture stiffens.
Roll the pastry onto a floured board worktable until pastry is about the same size as the base of the cake tin.
Lay out on baking sheet and bake for 20–25 minutes at 350°F, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Whip cream until it holds its shape.
Put some whipped cream into pastry piping bag with a star tip attached, and reserve this for the decoration.
Slice the cake horizontally into 3 equal-sized layers.
Drain the cherries, reserve 8 for decoration and remove the stones from the remainder.
Put pastry on serving plate and spread the pastry with black cherry jam.
Soak the cakes with brandy or cherry juice.
Put one layer of cake on top of coated pastry.
Spread a layer of cream on the cake, and top with half the stoned cherries.
Add the second layer of cake, then another layer of cream and cherries.
Top with the final layer of the cake.
Cover the entire cake with the remaining cream, and press on the grated chocolate.
Decorate the top with piped rosettes of cream and the reserved whole black cherries.

recipes.notes: Using 3 identical cake pans instead of 1 large one is acceptable. Margarine, vegetable oil or regular butter will substitute for Irish butter. In some countries (e.g. Austria and Australia) the brandy is often replaced by rum, in Germany itself it is almost always replaced by Kirschwasser. Cakes usually work at between 325°F and 400°F (160°C and 205°C). Pastries usually work at between 350°F and 425°F (175°C and 220°C). (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Blue Corn Mush
recipes.description: A creamy, lavender-gray porridge of finely ground blue cornmeal, a staple breakfast of the Hopi and Diné (Navajo) peoples of the Southwest.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 tsp culinary ash (juniper ash), optional, to deepen the blue color

steps.text: Stir the blue cornmeal into 1 cup of cold water to make a smooth paste.
Bring the remaining 3 cups of water and the salt to a boil in a saucepan.
If using, dissolve the juniper ash in 2 tablespoons of hot water and strain it into the pot.
Slowly whisk in the cornmeal paste, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring often, for 10–15 minutes until thick and smooth.
Serve hot, drizzled with honey or maple syrup if you like.

recipes.title: Blue Corn Pancakes
recipes.description: Light, nutty pancakes made with Southwestern blue cornmeal, a cornerstone grain of the Pueblo, Hopi, and Diné peoples.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3 tbsp melted butter, plus more for the griddle

steps.text: Whisk together the blue cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined; let rest 5 minutes.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium heat and brush it with butter.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look set, about 2 minutes.
Flip and cook 1–2 minutes more until cooked through.
Serve warm with maple syrup, honey, or wojapi.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffin
recipes.description: Blueberry muffins are a pastry common in many parts of the world.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) blueberries, fresh or frozen

steps.text: Grease muffin cups or line with paper cups; set aside.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Make a well in the center of the mixture and set aside.
In a small bowl, combine beaten egg, milk, and oil. Add this mixture all at once to the flour mixture. Fold in blueberries and stir just until combined. Do not overstir.
Spoon batter into prepared cups, filling each about two-thirds full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden. When a wooden toothpick is inserted near the middle, it should come out clean.
Remove from muffin cups and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.

recipes.notes: The mixture should be lumpy after stirring. Overstirring to make smooth batter will cause the muffins to be tough. Leaving the muffins in the muffin cups can make them soggy. To make jumbo muffins, reduce the temperature to 350°F (180°C) and bake for 30 minutes. To make mini muffins, bake for about 10 minutes at 400°F (200°C). (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Rob Pongsajapan from Arlington, VA, USA / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Blueberry_muffins.jpg

recipes.title: Boilo (Hot Spiced Citrus Whiskey)
recipes.description: Boilo is a traditional Yuletide drink of the north-eastern United States, specifically Pennsylvania. It is a type of whiskey-based liqueur made with oranges, lemons, sugar and various different spices such as cinnamon. Recipes vary and may include nutmeg, cloves, caraway seed and aniseed.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 12 oz (355 ml) whiskey or more to taste
1/2–1 teaspoon each of any or all of these spices: cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, caraway seed, aniseed

steps.text: Peel the oranges and lemons. Cut up the fruit and squeeze them into a crock pot. A garlic press or potato-ricer works, or some kind of juicer or fruit squeezer. Put the remaining fruit pulp into the crock pot as well.
Add the raisins, honey, and spices. Stir. Do not add whiskey yet!
Start the crock pot, and let the mixture cook for about 2–4 hours. Stir occasionally. It's complete when the fruit pulp gets cooked down.
Strain into a pitcher. Mash down the fruit in the strainer to get all the liquid.
Add the whiskey to the pitcher and stir. If you cook the whiskey, even for a short time, the alcohol will start to evaporate. Taste, and add more whiskey to your liking.
Serve hot in shot glasses, espresso cups, or coffee mugs. After the first round, each individual serving can be reheated in the microwave.

recipes.notes: Use a whiskey that is at least 80 proof (40% alcohol). (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Boxty (Irish Potato Cakes)
recipes.description: Variant of the traditional Irish fried potato cakes recipe. An old Irish rhyme goes as follows:Boxty on the griddle, Boxty in the pan, If you can't make boxty, You'll never get your man.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Take half of the potatoes and wash, peel, chunk, and boil them.
Mash the boiled potatoes with milk and 1 tablespoon butter and set them aside.
Grate the other pound of (raw) potatoes into a strong cloth.
Squeeze cloth to remove all possible liquid from the raw potatoes.
Mix together the grated potatoes, the mashed potatoes, baking soda, buttermilk, flour, and black pepper (to taste).
Stir thoroughly to combine.
Warm nonstick griddle or skillet over medium heat and melt butter.
Pour potato cakes on griddle, 1/4 cup at a time.
Fry until edges are soft and cake is bubbling.
Cook on other side.
Serve hot.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: さえぼー / Wikimedia Commons, CC0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Boxty_triangle.jpg

recipes.title: Braised Beef Brisket
recipes.description: Tender, slow-braised brisket with onions and a tangy-sweet sauce — the centerpiece of many Passover and Hanukkah dinners.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup dry red wine or more broth

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Season the brisket all over with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven or roasting pan over medium-high heat and brown the brisket well on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Add the onions to the pan and cook for 10 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Stir in the broth, wine, tomatoes, brown sugar, vinegar and bay leaves, scraping up the browned bits.
Return the brisket fat side up, spoon onions and sauce over it and tuck the carrots around it.
Cover tightly and braise in the oven for 3 to 3 1/2 hours, until fork-tender.
Let the brisket rest for 15 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.
Skim the fat from the sauce and serve it spooned over the sliced meat. Brisket is even better made a day ahead and reheated in its sauce.

recipes.photoCredit: Josh Evnin from Chicago, IL, USA / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Brisketphoto.jpg

recipes.title: Bratkartoffeln (German Fried Potatoes)
recipes.description: Sliced boiled potatoes fried in a cast-iron pan with bacon and onions until crisp and golden.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb waxy potatoes (such as Yukon Gold)

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins in salted water for 20 minutes until just tender, then drain and let cool completely, ideally overnight.
Peel the potatoes and slice them about 1/4 inch thick.
Cook the bacon in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat until crisp, then remove it, leaving the fat in the pan.
Add the butter to the pan, then add the potatoes in a single layer and fry without stirring for 5 to 7 minutes until golden on the bottom.
Turn the potatoes and continue frying, turning occasionally, for another 10 minutes until crisp all over.
Add the onion and caraway and fry for 5 minutes more until the onion is soft and browned.
Return the bacon to the pan, season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with parsley and serve with fried eggs or bratwurst.

recipes.title: Bread and Butter Pudding
recipes.description: Slices of buttered bread layered with raisins and baked in a vanilla-scented custard until puffed and golden.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Grease a 2-quart baking dish with butter.
Butter the bread on one side, cut each slice into triangles, and arrange half of them, buttered side up, in the dish.
Scatter half the raisins over, then add the remaining bread and raisins.
Whisk the eggs and sugar together, then whisk in the milk, cream, and vanilla.
Pour the custard evenly over the bread and let it soak for 20 minutes, pressing the bread down gently.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Sprinkle the top with nutmeg and demerara sugar.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the custard is just set and the top is crisp and golden.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving warm.

recipes.title: Brötchen (German Bread Rolls)
recipes.description: Crusty, airy German breakfast rolls with a crackly crust, perfect for butter, jam, cheese and cold cuts.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
