Hand-made burger patties change shape during cooking, with the edges shrinking in toward the middle. This causes the burger to be more ball-shaped than originally formed. To circumvent this, press the raw patties down much thinner than you want the finished burger to be.
Let the meat get to room temperature before cooking. This will help the burgers cook evenly and fully.
Do not add salt until right before you start cooking the patty.

If your burgers fall apart, adding an egg yolk will help keep it together. Buying lean ground beef will also help, although if the meat is too lean the burger may be excessively dry. Not mixing the ground meat in the first place will also ensure the patty's integrity.

steps.text: Shape the ground beef by hand into burger patties. You should get between 4–6 burgers from 500 g (1.1 lb) of beef.

If adding optional ingredients, either season the outside or mix into the beef before forming the patties. Overworking the beef will result in mushy meat that won't stick together, so only mix the minimum necessary and do so by hand.

Pan-fry or grill the patties for about 4–5 minutes on each side for burgers that aren't too thick. Ensure your burgers are fully cooked through before serving. If your burgers are quite thick or if you are unsure, you can cut one open to ensure the insides are browned. If the insides are red, there is a chance that the meat is not fully cooked. Alternately, you can insert a meat thermometer into the center of the burger, if the temperature reads less than 71°C (160°F), your burger is undercooked.
Let the burger rest for several minutes before serving to let the juices cool down and not burst out at first bite.
Serve each burger on a bun, optionally with relish, sliced pickles, ketchup, mayonnaise, mustard, ranch dressing, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes and/or onions.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Hash Browns
recipes.description: Hash browns or hashed browns are a simple potato preparation in which potato pieces are pan-fried after being shredded, julienned, diced, or riced. They are considered a breakfast food and are often served with ketchup. This recipe refers to the shredded version, which is the most common in many parts of the United States.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: Cooking oil (canola is good—see smoke point information)

steps.text: Grate the raw potatoes with a cheese grater, place them into a bowl and cover completely with water. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Drain the grated potatoes well; if this is not done thoroughly the potatoes will steam instead of fry.
Mix in chopped onions by hand.
Mix the egg OR flour into the hash brown mixture evenly. This will allow the hash browns to stay together when frying.
Place a large frying pan on medium-high heat and add enough oil to provide a thin coating over the entire bottom of the pan.

When the oil has come up to temperature apply a large handful of potatoes to the pan and reshape into a patty that is about 1/4–1/2 inch (6–12 mm) thick. The thinner the patty, the crispier the hash browns will be throughout.
Flip when they are crisp and brown on the cooking side. They should also stick together nicely before they are flipped. This should take about 5–8 minutes.
The hash browns are done when the new side is brown and crispy. This should take another 3–5 minutes.

recipes.notes: Try using rosemary instead of the onion. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Whitebox at English Wikipedia / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hashbrown_potato_patty.jpg

recipes.title: Hashbrown Casserole
recipes.description: This potato casserole recipe is a long-time favorite in Utah. It is super fattening but very good. You can reduce the fat by using low fat cheese and fat free sour cream, and omit the butter. You can also use low-fat cream of chicken soup.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1/4 cup melted butter (you can omit this to save calories and reduce the fat content)
1 cup corn flakes cereal tossed with 1 tablespoon melted butter for topping

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except cornflakes in a large bowl.
Transfer the mixture to an 11x13-inch glass baking dish.
Sprinkle the corn flake mixture on top.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes. It's done when it is all bubbly and a little bit browned on top.

recipes.notes: You can mince up a white or yellow onion and use in place of green onion. For a milder onion flavor you could substitute chives for the green onions. Instead of hash browns, you can also use those frozen potatoes O'Brien that have chunks of peppers in them. (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Haudenosaunee Strawberry Drink
recipes.description: A sweet, crushed strawberry drink served at the Haudenosaunee (Iroquois) Strawberry Festival, giving thanks for the first fruit of the year.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Crush the strawberries in a large bowl with a potato masher until juicy but still a little chunky.
Stir in the maple syrup and let stand for 15 minutes.
Add the cold water and stir well.
Taste and add more maple syrup if needed.
Chill and serve over ice with some of the crushed berries in each glass.

recipes.title: Haudenosaunee White Corn Soup
recipes.description: A traditional Iroquois soup of hulled white corn simmered with kidney beans and salt pork or smoked meat, served at gatherings and ceremonies.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb dried hulled white corn (Iroquois white corn or prepared hominy), or 3 cans (29 oz each) white hominy
1 lb salt pork or smoked pork hocks
2 cans (15 oz each) red kidney beans, drained, or 3 cups cooked

steps.text: If using dried white corn, soak it overnight in plenty of cold water and drain.
Place the corn and pork in a large pot with the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, for 2 1/2 hours until the corn kernels are tender and swollen (30 minutes if using canned hominy).
Remove the pork, pull or dice the meat, and return it to the pot, discarding bone and rind.
Add the kidney beans and turnip and simmer 30 minutes more.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Herbed Corn
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 7 ears sweet corn, husks and silks carefully removed

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except corn in small bowl. Mix well.
Measure about 1 tablespoon of the mixture and spread over each ear of corn.
Wrap each ear of corn in heavy foil.
Grill over medium heat 10–15 minutes, or until tender.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Herrencreme (German Custard Dessert)
recipes.description: Herrencreme is a German dessert based on custard and cream.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 packets (88 g) German custard powder (e.g. Dr. Oetker)

steps.text: Combine milk, sugar, salt, and custard powder in a saucepan. Cook, stirring, over medium heat until it has thickened.
Place a sheet of cling film on the surface of the pudding to prevent a skin from forming, and let cool completely.
Transfer the pudding to a bowl. Stir in rum and chocolate to taste.
Fold in the whipped cream.
Chill in fridge for about 2 hours.
Serve.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Hickory Smoked Chicken Breasts
recipes.description: When you get the job of smoked or barbecued chicken, do you weep in fear of flavorless breasts? It happens to everybody, even professional chefs. This is your solution.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 cups very hot apple cider vinegar
Several pounds of large hickory chunks

steps.text: Combine salt, honey, herbs, and vinegar in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add ice and shake until ice is mostly melted and mixture has cooled.
Add chicken and brine in the refrigerator for 1–2 hours.
Take chicken out of brine and pat dry with paper towels. Set aside.
Combine lemon pepper, peppercorns, chili powder, cayenne pepper, and paprika. Rub mixture gently into both sides of each chicken piece.

Place enough hickory wood chunks into the firebox of a smoker to keep the temperature around 225°F. Insert a probe thermometer into one of the chicken pieces and place in the smoker. Cook, changing chunks as needed, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove to a plate and let rest, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.notes: The quantity of salt called for may seem large, but very little of it will end up in the final product—most is discarded in the brine. (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Hidatsa Stuffed Pumpkin
recipes.description: A whole sugar pumpkin baked with a filling of bison, wild rice, and sunflower seeds, inspired by the Hidatsa and Mandan gardeners of the upper Missouri River.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 tbsp chopped fresh sage or 2 tsp dried

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cut a lid from the top of the pumpkin, scoop out the seeds and strings, and sprinkle the inside with 1/2 tsp salt.
Brown the bison with the onion in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes; add the garlic for the last minute and drain the fat.
Stir in the wild rice, sunflower seeds, sage, pepper, and remaining salt, and let cool slightly.
Mix in the eggs to bind the stuffing.
Pack the stuffing into the pumpkin, replace the lid, and set it in a baking dish with 1/2 inch of water.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours, until the pumpkin flesh is tender when pierced.
Cut into wedges, serving some pumpkin and stuffing with each slice.

recipes.title: Himmel und Erde (Heaven and Earth)
recipes.description: A Rhineland dish of mashed potatoes and apples ('earth' and 'heaven') topped with fried blood sausage or bratwurst and crisp onions.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb starchy potatoes, peeled and cubed
2 tart apples, peeled, cored and chopped
1 lb blood sausage (Blutwurst) or bratwurst, sliced thick

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile simmer the apples with the sugar, lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of water for 10 minutes until soft.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with 2 tablespoons of butter, the warm milk, salt and nutmeg.
Fold the cooked apples into the mashed potatoes, keeping some texture.
Fry the bacon in a skillet until crisp, then add the onions and cook until golden and caramelized; remove and keep warm.
In the same pan, melt the remaining butter and fry the sausage slices for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Spoon the potato-apple mash onto plates and top with the sausage, onions and bacon.

recipes.title: Homemade Corn Tortillas
recipes.description: Tortillas are a type of flatbread popular in Mexico and Central America, commonly made from wheat flour or masa. This recipe is for the masa (corn) variety; see Flour Tortilla for the wheat flour version.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: In a large bowl, stir together the masa and salt.
Add the water, and mix together well to form a dough.
Turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 1/4 cup (3 oz / 90 g) portions, and form them into balls.
Roll each ball into a flat round about 6 inches (10 cm) in diameter and 1/8 inches (0.25 cm) thick.
Heat a large heavy skillet over medium high heat.
Place the tortillas one at a time into the dry hot skillet; cook until brown on one side, then turn and brown the other side.
Remove from the skillet and keep warm in cloth towel.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Jon Sullivan / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Balboa_20_bg_120603.jpg

recipes.title: Homemade Corned Beef
recipes.description: Historically Irish Corned Beef has been world renowned for being served as the primary preserved meat on the Royal Navy ships of the 16th and 17th century, with no equal, even though unaffordable by the Irish peasants themselves.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 ea. (6 lb / 2.75 kg) round/brisket of corned beef

steps.text: Put the brisket on a bed of the carrots and onions in a large saucepan.
Just barely cover everything with room temperature water, add the allspice and cloves, and simmer lightly for 4 hours.
Add the beer, and simmer for another hour.

Serve it cold on Christmas. Since there is no need to slave in the kitchen this day, the brisket should be removed and pressed between 2 dishes with a weight on top, reserving the juice for hot topping gravy; other days you can serve hot.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Homemade Five-Spice Powder
recipes.description: Chinese five spice powder (五香粉, five spices powder, or five-spice powder) is a convenient seasoning for Cantonese cuisine. It incorporates the five basic flavours of Chinese cooking—sweet, sour, bitter, pungent, and salty. One common recipe includes China Tung Hing cinnamon, powdered cassia buds, powdered star anise and anise seed, ginger root, and ground cloves.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Toast the Szechuan peppercorns in a dry frying pan for about 3 minutes.
Grind the peppercorns in a pepper grinder or coffee grinder together with the star anise pods.
Sift the ground spices to remove any larger bits.
Mix together the cloves, cinnamon, and fennel seeds.
Grind the completed mixture until it is a very fine powder.
Use sparingly, as it is extremely pungent.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Homemade Hominy
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Put the water into a large kettle or saucepan, and stir in the lye.
Bring the water to a boil, and then add the corn. Let it boil until the skins will slip off the grains when they are pressed between the thumb and the finger.
Remove from the stove, stir sufficiently to loosen the skins, and then remove them by washing the corn in a colander.

Cover the grains with cold water and return to the fire. When the water boils, pour it off. Repeat this process at least three times, so as to make sure that there is no trace of the lye. Allow the grains to cook in more water until they burst.
Season the corn with the salt, and while still hot put it into a jar or a crock and cover it tight until it is to be used. The water in which the hominy is cooked should remain on it.

recipes.notes: A safer recipe substitutes baking soda (1 tablespoon per quart of water) for lye in the first boil. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Homemade Irish Cream Liqueur
recipes.description: A smooth, creamy whiskey liqueur made at home in minutes, lovely in coffee or over ice and a popular Christmas gift.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Pour all the ingredients into a blender.
Blend on low speed for 30 seconds until completely smooth; do not overblend or the cream may thicken.
Pour into clean glass bottles and seal tightly.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving to let the flavors meld.
Shake well before pouring and serve over ice or in coffee; keep refrigerated and use within 2 months.

recipes.title: Homemade Tortilla Chips
recipes.description: A tortilla chip is a snack food made from corn tortillas, which are cut into wedges and then fried, alternatively they may be discs pressed out of corn masa then fried or baked. Corn tortillas are made of corn, vegetable oil, salt and water. Although first mass-produced in Los Angeles in the late 1940s, tortilla chips are considered to be a Mexican food.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Fill a pot with 2 inches of oil.
Clip a frying thermometer to the side of the pot so that the tip is submerged in the oil but not touching the bottom.
Heat the oil to 360°F (180°C).
Slice a pile of tortillas in half through the centre.
Stack the two piles together and cut across the center again to form quarters.
Stack the quarters and cut through to form eighths
Gently drop the tortilla pieces into the hot oil, a handful at a time.
After the initial vapour has boiled off, agitate gently with a slotted spoon to fry evenly
When tortilla chips are golden brown (about 2 minutes), remove with a spider or slotted spoon.
Drain on paper towels and season lightly with salt or seasoned salt.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Homemade Wheat Tortillas
recipes.description: Tortillas are a type of flatbread popular in Mexico and Central America commonly made from wheat flour or masa. This recipe is for the wheat flour variety; see Corn Tortilla for the masa version..
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) warm water, or more if needed
4 teaspoons baking powder (optional, for thicker and chewier tortillas)

steps.text: In a large bowl, stir together the flour, salt and baking powder.
With a pastry blender, a fork, or your hands, gradually work in the lard or shortening until it is all incorporated.
Add enough warm water to make a soft but not sticky dough.
Turn out onto a lightly-floured board and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 1/4 cup (3 oz / 90 g) portions and form them into balls.
Roll each ball into a flat round about 6 inches (15 cm) in diameter and 1/8 inches (0.3 cm) thick. You can use a tortilla press for this.
Heat a large heavy skillet over medium high heat.
Place the tortillas one at a time into the dry (or very lightly oiled) hot skillet; cook until browned in spots on one side, then turn and brown the other in spots side (about 1 minute/side)
Remove from the skillet and keep warm in cloth towel.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NCI_flour_tortillas.jpg

recipes.title: Hominy Grits
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey, brown sugar, or maple syrup (optional)

steps.text: Bring water to a rapid boil in a saucepan.
Gradually stir in the hominy grits.
Reduce heat to low.
Stir in the butter.
Cook for 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed.
If desired, sweeten with honey, brown sugar, maple syrup, or jelly.
Serve while hot.

recipes.notes: Grits can also be flavored with cheese, sunny-side up egg, or small bits of ham or sausage. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Hong Kong Egg Tarts
recipes.description: Buttery short-crust tart shells filled with a smooth, glossy, just-set egg custard, a dim sum bakery favorite.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, powdered sugar, and salt together, then rub in the butter with your fingertips until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Mix in the egg yolk and cold water until the dough just comes together, then wrap and chill for 30 minutes.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and let it cool to room temperature.
Whisk the eggs gently with the evaporated milk and vanilla, stir in the cooled sugar syrup, and strain twice through a fine sieve.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Divide the dough into 12 pieces and press each into a greased 3-inch tart tin or standard muffin cup, bringing it just above the rim.
Fill each shell about 90 percent full with custard.
Bake for 10 minutes, then reduce the oven to 350°F (175°C) and bake for 12 to 15 minutes more until the custard is set but still jiggles slightly.
Cool in the tins for 10 minutes, then unmold and serve warm.

recipes.photoCredit: LNAM Haoi / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HK_SSP_%E9%95%B7%E6%B2%99%E7%81%A3_Cheung_Sha_Wan_%E6%B7%B1%E7%9B%9B%E8%B7%AF_Sham_Shing_Road_%E6%B3%93%E6%99%AF%E6%BB%99%E5%95%86%E5%A0%B4_Banyan_Mall_shop_%E8%9B%8B%E6%92%BB%E7%8E%8B_King_Bakery_Studio_December_2019_SS2_egg_tarts.jpg

recipes.title: Hong Kong Milk Tea
recipes.description: Strong, smooth black tea brewed and pulled until silky, then mixed with evaporated and sweetened condensed milk.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk, or to taste

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil in a small saucepan.
Add the tea leaves, reduce the heat, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour the tea through a fine strainer or tea sock into a heatproof pitcher, then pour it back into the saucepan.
Repeat pouring the tea back and forth through the strainer 4 or 5 times to give it a smoother, richer body.
Simmer for 2 more minutes, then strain into two cups.
Stir in the evaporated milk and condensed milk and serve hot, or cool and pour over ice.

recipes.title: Hongshao Rou (Red Braised Pork Belly)
recipes.description: Hongshao rou (lit. red-cooked meat) is a traditional Chinese pork dish. It is a very popular homemade dish, but it is rarely found in Western restaurants. Often a family's exact recipe is a secret and passed down the generations. It consists of pork belly in a thick, sweet, dark sauce, simmered for a long time to soften the normally tough meat.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: In a medium saucepan, over high heat, heat the oil and sugar together until the sugar melts and turns brown.
Add the cubed pork to the sugar and oil and brown all over.
Reduce the heat, add the stock, ginger, star anise, soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine to the pan.
Cover tightly and simmer for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent it burning at the bottom.
Remove the lid and add the spring onions.
Boil the sauce until only a thick, dark gravy is left.
The dish may be served now, but if possible, refrigerate for a day to allow the flavours to develop.
Serve with rice, garnish with sliced spring onion.

recipes.notes: Add 500 g sliced tripe. If the tripe was frozen, boil vigorously for about 40 mins until tender and not chewy. If fresh tripe is used (highly recommended) this is not required. Add to the pan about halfway through the simmering. Add 250 g beef tendon, cut into small cubes. Boil vigorously for about 40 mins until translucent and not too chewy. Add this to the pan about halfway through the simmering.

recipes.title: Horchata
recipes.description: Horchata is a Mexican almond rice-water beverage.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 15 slivers lime peel, 2 inches in length

steps.text: Soaking: Thoroughly pulverize the rice in a blender.
Transfer to a medium size bowl and add the almonds, cinnamon stick, and lime peel.
Stir in 12 cups of hot water.
Cover and let stand at least 6 hours or overnight.
Blending: Place the mixture in the blender and blend for 3–4 minutes, until it no longer feels gritty.
Add 10 cups cold water and blend until combined.
Strain a little at a time using a chinois or strainer lined with cheesecloth.
Finishing: Add 10 cups of cold water and stir in enough sugar to sweeten the drink to taste.
If the consistency is too thick, add additional water.
Cover and refrigerate. Stir before pouring.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Hot and Sour Soup
recipes.description: Hot and sour soup is a popular soup served at Chinese restaurants in the United States. This version tastes exactly like that served at various Chinese restaurants in California.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 6 cups chicken stock or broth (or 4 cups water and 4 chicken bouillon cubes)
1/3 cup cooked shredded chicken or pork
4 1/2 oz block of tofu, cut into 1/4-inch dice
3 tablespoons cornstarch and 2 tablespoons cold water

steps.text: Bring chicken broth to a simmer in a 2-quart saucepan.
Add soy sauce, shredded meat, mushrooms and garlic chili sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add black pepper, white vinegar, bamboo shoots, tofu. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Combine 3 tablespoons of cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of cold water in a cup. Stir until mixture is smooth. Add cornstarch mixture to soup and stir well.
Simmer for 5 minutes until soup is thickened.
Beat egg in a cup until yolk and white are combined. Pour beaten egg slowly, in a fine stream into soup. Stir soup several times, then wait 30 seconds.
Add green onions and sesame oil to soup. Stir well and remove from heat.
Serve hot.

recipes.notes: Adjust vinegar, ground black pepper, garlic chili sauce and soy sauce to taste. American vinegar is much more acidic than its Chinese counterpart, so start with very little and add slowly. Add or remove mushrooms, bamboo shoots, or tofu as needed. These three ingredients don't add much to the taste, mostly they add to the texture of the soup. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Hot Cross Bun
recipes.description: Hot cross buns are a popular and tasty yeasted pastry traditionally served before Easter.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Buns: Heat milk and water to lukewarm.
Crumble yeast. Mix with 1/2 cup (120 ml) flour. Stir in tepid milk/water and mix well.
Cover and set aside in warm place until yeast is active and frothing, about 10–15 minutes.
Mix remaining flour, sugar, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Stir egg and butter into the yeast mix, add the flour mixture and fruit. Mix well.
Put dough onto a floured surface and knead. Return to bowl, and let rise until double in bulk, about 1 hour.
Turn onto a floured surface and knead again.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Divide dough into twelve pieces and shape into buns. Mark a deep cross on the top of each bun.
Arrange on a baking tray, cover with tea towel, and let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in preheated 375°F (190°C) oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Glaze: Mix together flour, vegetable oil and golden syrup.
Remove buns from tray and glaze.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Hot Whiskey
recipes.description: Ireland's cure-all: Irish whiskey with hot water, lemon, cloves, and brown sugar, sipped on cold nights.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Warm a heatproof glass by filling it with hot water, then empty it.
Stud the lemon slice with the cloves.
Add the brown sugar and whiskey to the glass.
Pour in the boiling water and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Drop in the clove-studded lemon slice and serve hot.

recipes.photoCredit: Patrick Truby / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hot_toddy_(1).jpg

recipes.title: Hot Wings
recipes.description: Hot wings are a dish of seasoned and fried chicken wings tossed in a spicy sauce.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 12 whole chicken wings, tip removed and cut in half

steps.text: To make the sauce, combine melted butter, hot sauce, minced garlic, and soy sauce in a stainless steel bowl.
Preheat oil to 350°F (180°C).
Combine seasoning salt, pepper, and wings. Toss to coat.
Fry wings in batches in oil for 11 minutes. Drain on a rack. Do not use paper towels—they will make the food greasy.
Toss wings with sauce and serve warm.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Clotee Pridgen Allochuku / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Buffalo_wings-01.jpg

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.description: Huevos Rancheros (Spanish for "eggs ranch-style") is a traditional Mexican country breakfast. From its home in Mexico, the dish has spread throughout the Americas.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1 tablespoon cilantro or parsley (optional), finely chopped

steps.text: To prepare the ranchero sauce, in a skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and optional garlic, and sauté until softened but not brown (4–5 minutes).
Add the tomatoes, peppers, chili powder, salt and a few grinds of black pepper and reduce to a simmer. Simmer for about 10 minutes, until the sauce begins to thicken up.
Add the cilantro or parsley, turn off the heat and cover the pan to keep the sauce warm.
In another skillet, lightly fry the tortillas in 1 tablespoon of oil. Remove and drain.
If necessary, add additional oil to the second skillet, and fry the eggs until they are "sunny-side up". Transfer the eggs to the tortillas, and cover with the ranchero sauce.

recipes.notes: Add sliced avocado, shredded Monterey Jack cheese, refried beans, or fried potatoes. Scramble the eggs instead of frying them. Quick and simple method is to scramble eggs and add salsa to taste. Huevos rancheros (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Pour oil 3–4 inches (7.5 cm to 10 cm) deep in a pan and preheat to 370°F (~190°C).
In bowl mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cayenne.
Mix in eggs, green onions, milk, and 1/4 cup vegetable oil.
Spoon 6–7 tablespoons of the batter into preheated oil.
Fry, stirring constantly for overall browning, until golden brown.
Remove from heat and drain on paper towels.

recipes.notes: 1/3 cup minced green onions may be substituted for fresh onions. Add 6 oz (170 g) pimento cheese to the batter. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Idli (Steamed Rice and Black Gram Bread)
recipes.description: Idli is a round, fluffy bread roughly eight centimetres in diameter. It is made from ground rice or rice flour mixed with ground urad dal, salt, methi (fenugreek seeds) and water. The mixture is allowed to ferment prior to being steamed in an idli steamer. They are traditional to Southern India and are most often eaten with sambar.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 cups chlorine-free water for fermenting (see note)

steps.text: Batter: Wash rice and urad dal thoroughly.

Soak the rice and urad dal in separate bowls for no more than 2 hours. Soak methi seeds along with the urad dal. You will need about twice as much water in the bowl as urad dal, as it expands as it soaks up water.
Drain the rice and urad dal. Do not discard the dal soaking water, but do discard the rice soaking water.
Grind the urad dal to a fine paste in a blender. If needed, add some of the reserved soaking water.
Grind the rice to a paste with about 1 cup of chlorine-free water (less if you can). Grind coarsely if the batter will only be used for idli, but grind finely if it will later be used for dosa.
Mix the rice and urad dal pastes together well, and season with salt.
If desired, stir in the fermentation starter and mix well (see note).
Set aside somewhere warm like to ferment for 8 hours (see note).
Grease one or more idli pans well with ghee or vegetable oil.
Gently spoon the batter into the round indentations of the idli pans. Do not stir or otherwise break the batter. The trapped bubbles should not escape as they are necessary for a fluffy texture.
Steam for 12 minutes in a steamer (16 minutes if using brown rice).
Remove idli from pans with a sharp knife or thin spatula.

recipes.notes: A traditional stone grinder is recommended for making idlis. A blender will do a reasonable job; do not use a food processor. Idli is made of black lentil and rice. The southern parts of India use boiled rice, while the rest uses raw rice. It depends on your taste. The black lentil should be the full, round variety. Avoid broken dal. The ratio of black lentil to rice should not exceed 1:3 or 1:4 by volume. If you have good quality dal, you can stretch this ratio by increasing the quantity of rice. The rice is typically parboiled short grain white rice, but brown rice works well also and adds flavour, colour, and more nutrition. Brown rice needs to be soaked at least 4–6 hours. Mix the dal and rice batters thoroughly. It takes more time and energy than you might think. Uneven mixing causes many failures. Mixing them by hand works best! A warm temperature is essential for fermentation. 25– (Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Nick Gray / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Idli1.jpg

recipes.title: Inarizushi (Stuffed Sushi)
recipes.description: Inarizushi (稲荷寿司, "stuffed sushi") encloses sushi rice and filling in a pocket made of paper-thin omelet, fried tofu, or a cabbage leaf. What follows is the recipe for a version of the recipe which uses omelet (egg) as a wrapper instead of the traditional fried tofu (Japanese: abura a-ge).
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Wrapper: Break the eggs into the bowl. Removing the egg white clinging to the yolk will make for a smoother and more uniform surface.
Add the sake, sugar, and salt.
Beat the mixture to produce a smooth, consistent texture, but not so much as to create a foam. If you accidentally get air bubbles, let the bowl sit for a few minutes while they pop.
Dissolve the cornstarch in the water—it will be closer to a paste than a fluid—and then add it to the egg mix.
Heat the pan over medium heat. If you are not using a non-stick pan, you will need to oil the surface.
Pour 3–4 tablespoons (40–50 ml) of the egg mixture all at once onto the pan.
Swirl the pan to spread the mixture thinly and evenly.
Allow the mixture to cook until the edges start to dry out. Remove the pan from the heat, and let the egg mixture continue to cook for 30 seconds from the heat in the pan.
Flip the omelet over and return the pan to the heat for 30 seconds.
Remove the omelet from the pan, and allow it to cool. You can store these omelets in the refrigerator for a few days.
Shape the sushi rice into oblong shapes.
Place a piece of sushi rice in the center of one of the egg wrappers.
Fold the edges of the wrapper over to enclose the rice.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Indian Butter Chicken I
recipes.description: Butter chicken or murgh makhani is an Indian dish popular in countries all over the world where Indian restaurants are found. The dish was invented by accident at Moti Mahal Restaurant in Daryaganj, New Delhi. While the dish's general recipe is well known, the actual flavor can vary from restaurant to restaurant even within Delhi.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 400–500 g of skinless, boneless chicken thighs or breasts (with the bone, this will probably be 800 g)

steps.text: Trim and cut the chicken into small cubes. If you prefer chicken on the bone, cut long thin slices laterally into the chicken.

In a big bowl combine the tandoori powder, yogurt, lemon juice, and chicken. Massage this well with your hands so that all the chicken is evenly covered in the Tandoori powder. Cover and put aside for at least 1/2 an hour.
Heat a large saucepan or frying pan until evenly hot.

In the pan melt 2 tablespoons of butter until it is frothy. Add the onions and the cinnamon to the pan and fry lightly. When the onions are soft and starting to brown, stir in the crushed garlic and ginger. Then add the turmeric, chili, and coriander, and sauté over a medium heat.
Add the chicken and sauté, stirring constantly until the chicken has turned white. This doesn't take long, so make sure you don't overcook the chicken.
Mix in the tomato paste. Add the cream and heat through. After adding the cream and stirring, you may add additional tandoori masala. About 3–5 tablespoons is generally sufficient.
Cover and simmer for just over 10 minutes.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Indian Ice Cream
recipes.description: Indian ice-cream or sxusem (pronounced "s-khushem", with "kh" sound resembling the final sound in the Scottish word 'loch') is a dessert made by native people throughout the Pacific Northwest region of North America. Traditionally this foam was eaten at larger gatherings with wooden spoons and children were known to play with the foam, sometimes throwing it at each other.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: optional sweeteners may include fireweed, camas bulb (Camassia quamash) or sweet berries such as salal berries (Gaultheria shallon), or thimbleberries. Nowadays many people sweeten it with sugar.

steps.text: Crush berries to release the liquid/juice.
Combine juice with an equal part of water.
Add sweetener.
Whip it with a whisk until foamy, similar in texture to whipped cream.

recipes.notes: A branch of soapberries can be shaken over a metal or glass container until all of the ripe berries fall off. Oily or plastic containers will prevent frothing. (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Irish Apple Cake
recipes.description: A moist, buttery cake studded with tart apples and topped with crunchy sugar, traditionally served warm with custard or cream.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3 tart cooking apples (such as Granny Smith), peeled, cored, and chopped
2 tbsp demerara or turbinado sugar, for topping

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease and line a 9-inch springform pan.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt together in a large bowl.
Rub the cold butter into the flour with your fingertips until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs, then stir in the granulated sugar.
Beat the eggs with the milk and vanilla, then stir into the dry ingredients to make a thick, soft batter.
Fold in the chopped apples until evenly distributed.
Spread the batter in the prepared pan and sprinkle the demerara sugar evenly over the top.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until golden brown and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then release the sides and serve warm with custard, whipped cream, or vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Irish Buttermilk Scones
recipes.description: Light, tender scones made with buttermilk, perfect split warm and spread with butter and jam.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3/4 cup buttermilk, plus 1 tbsp for brushing

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
Rub the butter into the flour with your fingertips until it resembles coarse breadcrumbs, then stir in the raisins if using.
Beat the egg with the buttermilk, pour into the flour mixture, and stir with a fork just until a soft dough forms.
Turn out onto a floured surface, knead lightly 3 or 4 times, and pat to a 1-inch (2.5 cm) thickness.
Cut out rounds with a floured 2 1/2-inch cutter, pressing straight down without twisting, and place on the baking sheet.
Brush the tops with buttermilk.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until risen and golden, then cool slightly and serve with butter and jam.

recipes.photoCredit: User:Dave souza / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.5 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Scone_varieties.jpg

recipes.title: Irish Coffee
recipes.description: Hot coffee spiked with Irish whiskey and brown sugar, crowned with a float of lightly whipped cream.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 5 oz (2/3 cup) hot, strong brewed coffee
2 tbsp heavy cream, lightly whipped until just thickened

steps.text: Warm a stemmed glass or mug by filling it with hot water, then empty it.
Add the brown sugar and pour in the hot coffee, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Stir in the Irish whiskey.
Hold a spoon upside down just above the surface of the coffee and slowly pour the lightly whipped cream over the back of the spoon so it floats on top.
Serve immediately without stirring, drinking the coffee through the cool cream.

recipes.photoCredit: jules / stone soup / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Irish_coffee_glass.jpg

recipes.title: Irish Cream Cheesecake
recipes.description: A rich baked cheesecake flavored with Irish cream liqueur on a chocolate cookie crust, topped with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C) and wrap the outside of a 9-inch springform pan with foil.
Mix the cookie crumbs with the melted butter, press firmly into the bottom of the pan, and bake for 10 minutes; let cool.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then beat in the flour.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating on low speed just until combined.
Mix in the Irish cream, sour cream, and vanilla until smooth, scraping the bowl well.
Pour the filling over the crust and set the pan in a roasting pan; pour hot water into the roasting pan to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 55 to 65 minutes, until the edges are set but the center still wobbles slightly.
Turn off the oven, crack the door, and let the cheesecake cool inside for 1 hour, then refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.
Whip the cream with the powdered sugar and Irish cream to soft peaks.
Spread or pipe the cream over the cheesecake and finish with grated chocolate before slicing.

recipes.title: Irish Fish Pie
recipes.description: Chunks of salmon, white fish, and smoked haddock in a creamy parsley sauce, topped with mashed potatoes and baked until golden.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb floury potatoes, peeled and quartered
12 oz skinless cod or haddock fillet

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender, drain, and mash with 2 tablespoons butter and 1/4 cup milk.
Place the 2 1/2 cups milk, bay leaf, and onion in a wide pan, add all the fish, and poach gently for 6 to 8 minutes until just cooked.
Lift out the fish, flake it into large chunks, and place in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish; strain and reserve the milk.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the reserved poaching milk and simmer, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes until thick and smooth.
Stir in the parsley, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, then pour the sauce over the fish and tuck in the egg quarters.
Spread the mashed potatoes over the top, fork the surface, dot with the remaining butter, and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbling and golden brown, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.photoCredit: Atelier Joly / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fish_Pie.jpg

recipes.title: Irish Fruit Cake
recipes.description: This is a variation of fruit cake that originated in Ireland.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Sift together flour, salt and baking powder.
Cream together butter and sugar; this may take 5–10 minutes.
Beat in eggs individually, incorporating each fully before adding the next.
Fold in fruits then the dry mixture.
Transfer batter to a greased and parchment-lined 8-inch cake pan.
Bake on the center rack for 75–90 minutes. Check for doneness after 60 minutes.
Let cake cool to room temperature in pan.
Remove to a wire tray, cover with towel, and allow to sit until completely cool.

recipes.notes: This particular version of the recipe does not include whiskey. If you were to add it, it would be added along with the butter and sugar. Approximately 1 quart should be used. This recipe uses raisins and cherries but apples, strawberries, or raspberries can be substituted. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: zingyyellow...! from Wales Cymru UK / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bara_Brith_(3320696816).jpg

recipes.title: Irish Nettle Soup
recipes.description: A bright green spring tonic made from young nettle tops, potatoes, and onion, traditionally eaten in Ireland in early spring.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 8 cups (about 6 oz) young nettle tops, picked with gloves

steps.text: Wearing gloves, wash the nettle tops well and discard any tough stalks.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium-low heat and cook the onion and leek for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the potatoes, stock, salt, and pepper, bring to a boil, and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the nettles and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes until they wilt and turn deep green.
Purée the soup until smooth with an immersion blender or in a blender.
Stir in the cream, reheat gently, and adjust the seasoning.
Serve hot with a swirl of cream and brown bread.

recipes.photoCredit: Ewan Munro from London, UK / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:St_John_Restaurant,_Smithfield,_London_(3445306202).jpg

recipes.title: Irish Pancakes with Lemon and Sugar
recipes.description: Thin, crêpe-like pancakes sprinkled with sugar and lemon juice, the beloved Irish way to celebrate Shrove Tuesday.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 tbsp butter, melted, plus extra for the pan

steps.text: Sift the flour and salt into a bowl and make a well in the center.
Crack in the eggs, add a little of the milk, and whisk, gradually drawing in the flour.
Whisk in the remaining milk and the melted butter to make a smooth batter the consistency of light cream, then rest it for 15 minutes.
Heat an 8-inch skillet over medium-high heat and brush lightly with butter.
Pour in about 3 tablespoons of batter and swirl to coat the base thinly.
Cook for about 1 minute until the underside is golden, then flip and cook for 30 seconds more.
Slide onto a warm plate, sprinkle with sugar, squeeze over lemon juice, and roll up or fold into quarters.
Repeat with the remaining batter, serving each pancake as it is made.

recipes.photoCredit: David Monniaux / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Crepes_dsc07085.jpg

recipes.title: Irish Pastie
recipes.description: Not to be confused with its Cornish counterpart, the pastie could be considered one of Northern Ireland's national dishes at it is regularly bought from chip shops across the province and generally can't be found anywhere else. Here is a recipe to try your own version.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork or beef, cooked and drained
3 medium-sized potatoes, boiled, mashed, and cooled

steps.text: Combine the cooked meat, breadcrumbs, cooked onion, parsley, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, water, coriander, and mashed potatoes.
Form the mixture into a disc about 3 inches in diameter.
Dip the disc into the batter so it's completely covered.
Deep-fry in 375°F oil, and remove when golden brown.
Serve hot with chips (French fries).

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Irish Porridge
recipes.description: Creamy, slow-cooked steel-cut oatmeal with a pinch of salt, finished with brown sugar, cream, and a drizzle of honey or a splash of whiskey.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup fresh berries or sliced banana (optional)

steps.text: Bring the water and milk to a boil in a heavy saucepan.
Stir in the oats and salt, reduce the heat to low, and simmer, stirring often, for 25 to 30 minutes until thick and creamy.
Add a splash more water or milk if the porridge becomes too thick before the oats are tender.
Remove from the heat, cover, and let stand for 2 minutes.
Spoon into bowls and top each with brown sugar or honey, a little cream, and fruit if using.

recipes.photoCredit: Renee Comet (Photographer) / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Oatmeal_(1).jpg

recipes.title: Irish Porter Cake
recipes.description: A dense, moist fruit cake made with stout and spice, a traditional Irish teatime and Christmas cake that keeps for weeks.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3 cups mixed dried fruit (raisins, sultanas, currants)
2 tsp ground mixed spice (or 1 tsp cinnamon plus 1/2 tsp each nutmeg and allspice)

steps.text: Place the butter, brown sugar, and stout in a large saucepan and heat gently until the butter melts and the sugar dissolves.
Add the dried fruit, mixed peel, and orange zest, bring to a boil, and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from the heat and let cool until just warm, about 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C) and grease and line an 8-inch round deep cake pan with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, and mixed spice together.
Stir the beaten eggs into the cooled fruit mixture, then fold in the flour mixture until no dry streaks remain.
Spoon the batter into the pan and level the top.
Bake for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours, covering loosely with foil if browning too quickly, until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool completely in the pan, then wrap well; the flavor improves after a day or two.

recipes.photoCredit: Peter Alfred Hess from United States / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chocolate_Stout_Cake.jpg

recipes.title: Irish Rhubarb Tart
recipes.description: A homely shortcrust pastry tart filled with sweet-tart rhubarb, a springtime favorite in Irish kitchens.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb rhubarb, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch pieces

steps.text: Mix the flour, sugar, and salt, then rub in the butter until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Add the egg yolk and enough ice water to bring the dough together, divide in two, wrap, and chill for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and place a baking sheet in the oven to heat.
Toss the rhubarb with the sugar and cornstarch.
Roll out one piece of pastry and line a 9-inch pie plate, then fill with the rhubarb mixture.
Roll out the second piece, lay it over the filling, trim, and crimp the edges to seal.
Brush the top with beaten egg, sprinkle with sugar, and cut a few steam vents.
Bake on the hot baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes until the pastry is golden and the juices bubble through the vents.
Cool for at least 30 minutes and serve warm with custard or softly whipped cream.

recipes.photoCredit: Colonel Warden at English Wikipedia / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rhubarb_tart.jpg

recipes.title: Irish Sausage Rolls
recipes.description: Seasoned pork sausage meat wrapped in flaky puff pastry, a staple of Irish parties, picnics, and deli counters.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Mix the sausage meat, onion, breadcrumbs, parsley, thyme, and pepper in a bowl until well combined.
Cut each pastry sheet in half lengthwise to make four long strips.
Divide the sausage mixture into four and roll each into a log the length of the pastry, then lay it along one long edge of each strip.
Brush the far edge of the pastry with beaten egg, roll the pastry over the filling, and press to seal with the seam underneath.
Cut each log into 6 pieces, place on the baking sheets, and cut two small slashes in the top of each.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds if using.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes until puffed, golden, and cooked through, then serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Irish Seafood Chowder
recipes.description: A creamy, smoky chowder loaded with fish and shellfish, served all along the Irish coast with a slice of brown bread.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 8 oz skinless salmon fillet, cut into chunks
8 oz smoked haddock or cod, cut into chunks

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat and cook the bacon for 4 minutes until it renders its fat.
Add the onion, leek, celery, and carrots and cook gently for 6 to 8 minutes until softened but not browned.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute, then pour in the wine and let it bubble for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the fish stock, then add the potatoes and bay leaf.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until the potatoes are just tender.
Add the salmon and smoked fish, then scatter the mussels on top, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes until the mussels open; discard any that stay closed.
Stir in the cream and pepper and heat through gently without boiling.
Remove the bay leaf, taste for salt, sprinkle with parsley, and serve with brown soda bread and butter.

recipes.title: Irish Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: Minced lamb simmered with vegetables in a rich stout gravy and topped with buttery mashed potatoes, baked until golden.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb floury potatoes, peeled and quartered

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender, drain, and mash with the butter, milk, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the lamb for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up; spoon off excess fat.
Add the onion, carrots, and celery and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir, then add the stout, stock, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, remaining salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the gravy is thick, then stir in the peas.
Spread the filling in a 9x13-inch or 3-quart baking dish and spoon the mashed potatoes over, sealing to the edges.
Rough up the surface with a fork so it crisps in the oven.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbling and golden on top, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.photoCredit: Oxfordian Kissuth / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Homerton_College_-_Shepherd%27s_pie_(cropped).jpg

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
recipes.description: Conventional bread, containing live yeast, leavens (rises) as the micro-organisms make carbon dioxide gas as a by-product of their metabolism. Similarly, soda bread utilizes the reaction between baking soda and vinegar, or some other acid, to make the bread rise through the production of carbon dioxide. This recipe uses buttermilk, or optionally a combination of milk and vinegar, but other recipes use sour cream.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C).
Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Blend egg and buttermilk together, and add all at once to the flour mixture.
Mix until just moistened. Too much mixing will make it tough.
Stir in butter; pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 65–70 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the bread comes out clean. The loaf should sound hollow if you tap the base.
Cool on a wire rack.
Wrap in tea-towel or foil several hours or overnight for best flavor.

recipes.notes: May serve toasted and buttered. Soda bread rises as a result of acid being mixed with baking soda. The acid is commonly in the form of vinegar, lemon juice, or buttermilk. A tablespoon of lemon juice or vinegar in one cup of milk can be substituted for each cup of buttermilk. For best results, bake it at 375°F (190°C), for about 50 minutes, on a preheated baking stone.
recipes.photoCredit: w:en:User:Canterbury Tail / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ben_W_Bell_Soda_Bread_Farl_05_June_2007.jpg

recipes.title: Irish Stew
recipes.description: Irish stew (Irish: stobhach gaelach) is a traditional Irish dish made from lamb or mutton as well as potatoes, onions and parsley. It originated in Ireland but appears in cookbooks all over Europe, including in Escoffier's Guide Culinaire. Although traditionally made with lamb or mutton, Irish stew was basically a cheap meal which was thrown together with left-overs and filled out with potatoes.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) deboned mutton, cut in chunks
4 large potatoes, peeled and thickly sliced
3–4 medium carrots, peeled and thickly sliced

steps.text: Choose a pot with a well-fitting lid and put in the ingredients in layers, starting and finishing with potatoes. Pour in the water and season to taste.
Cover and put on a very low heat for about 2 1/2 hours until the meat is tender and the potatoes have thickened the liquid.

recipes.notes: The dish may also be made with lamb, in which case it requires only 1 1/2 hours cooking time. (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: A Healthier Michigan from Detroit, United States / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Irish_Beef_Stew_(34046928633).jpg

recipes.title: Irish Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: The smooth, thick blended vegetable soup served in every Irish pub and home kitchen, best with a wedge of brown bread.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium-low heat.
Add the onion, leek, carrots, celery, and parsnip, cover, and sweat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened but not browned.
Add the potatoes, stock, salt, and pepper and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer, partly covered, for 25 minutes until all the vegetables are very tender.
Purée the soup with an immersion blender or in batches in a blender until smooth.
Stir in the milk or cream and reheat gently without boiling.
Taste for seasoning, sprinkle with parsley, and serve with brown soda bread.

recipes.title: Jalebi (Fritters in Syrup)
recipes.description: Jalebi is a sweet fritter that is shaped like a slightly large, chaotic pretzel. It is traditionally prepared in India and Pakistan. Well-made jalebi has a tart element with a sweet taste.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 3 cups of vegetable oil/ghee for deep frying

steps.text: Mix up the batter ingredients until smooth.
Let the batter sit unrefrigerated and uncovered overnight (about 12 hours).
Mix the sugar, water, and cream of tartar for the syrup.
Stir the syrup over moderate heat until the sugar is dissolved.
Put on high heat and boil for 5 minutes.
Let the syrup cool, and stir in the rosewater. Use food coloring to tint it light orange.
Put the vegetable oil in a wide wok-like dish, and heat to about 350°F (175°C).
Put the batter into a pastry bag with about a 1/4 inch opening. If it is too dry to squeeze out, mix in a bit of water.
Squeeze the batter into the oil, making a couple of figure-eight shapes and loops on top of each other. The shape should be about 3 inches on its longest side.
Fry each jalebi until golden brown. Remove, let the oil drain off, then soak in syrup for a minute.
Serve.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Jam Roly-Poly
recipes.description: Jam roly-poly is a traditional British cuisine probably invented in the early 19th century. It is a flat-rolled suet pudding, which is then spread with jam and rolled up. In days past, Jam Roly-Poly was also known as shirt-sleeve pudding, because it was often steamed and served in an old shirt-sleeve. Because of this, another nickname for the pudding was dead-man's arm.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 250 g (1 cup or 8 oz) self-rising flour
125 g (1/2 cup or 4 oz) shredded suet

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Sift the flour into a bowl with the salt. Add the suet and sufficient water to create a soft but not sticky dough.
Turn on to a floured board and roll out to a rectangle about 20×30 cm (8×12 inches).
Brush the pastry with the warmed jam, leaving a 1 cm (1/2 inch) border all around.
Fold in this border and brush with milk. With the short side towards you, roll up the pastry loosely and seal the ends well.
Place on a greased baking sheet, with the sealed edge underneath. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with caster sugar.
Bake in the oven for 35–40 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from the oven, sprinkle on a little more sugar and serve hot with home-made English custard.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: EAT&ART TARO / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jam_roly-poly02.jpg

recipes.title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Combine rum and mustard, and rub all over chicken.
Combine remaining ingredients and rub all over chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, but it is better to marinate overnight.
Place chicken on a greased, preheated charcoal grill. Cook, turning constantly until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.notes: The spices always included allspice because the berries of the pimento tree are the source of allspice. When cooking the meat, barbecue is by far the best technique—failing that, oven bake. Basting with beer is worth trying. Serve with rice and peas. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: OUTography.com from Gilbert, AZ, USA / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BBQJerk_Chicken.jpg

recipes.title: Jambalaya I
recipes.description: Jambalaya, one of Louisiana's most famous dishes, is rooted in Spanish and French cuisine and is the New World version of paella.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 14.5 ounces (411 g) canned tomatoes, diced or torn apart
2 cups cooked and chopped turkey or chicken
1 small can of sliced mushrooms (optional), drained

steps.text: Mix the salt, savory, basil, thyme, and cumin together, then grind them to a powder.
Prepare the canned tomatoes: tear them up, remove the stem ends, remove the seeds, etc. Keep the juice.
Heat a wide pan with a lid. Lightly fry the celery in the butter. Soften the celery but do not brown it.
Add everything to the pan. You can add the basil, meat, and mushrooms later if you prefer.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for about 20 minutes. The rice will absorb the liquid.
Discard the bay leaf.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Polyparadigm~commonswiki assumed (based on  / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jambalaya.JPG

recipes.title: Jambons
recipes.description: Jambons are a type of square pastry filled with cheese and ham. The name is derived from the French word for ham, and they are common in Ireland and the UK.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 150 g grated cheese (Dubliner Cheese recommended, can be substituted)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Melt butter over medium heat and add flour. Cook for 5 minutes and begin adding milk gradually until the mixture thickens.
Cut your pre-prepared puff pastry into squares and spoon a generous amount of the mixture onto each square. Sprinkle some ham and grated cheese on top.
Fold the corners of the puff pastry so that they meet in the centre, forming a panier feuilleté (puff pastry basket) shape.
Beat the egg and brush it over each sealed panier feuilleté.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until puffed and golden brown.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Japanese Pickled Plums (Umeboshi)
recipes.description: Umeboshi (梅干, pickled Japanese plum) is a kind of pickled food. It is one of the Japanese traditional foods and it has been popular in Japan. It is red and round, and its taste ranges from sour to sweet. The texture can range from dry and crunchy to saturated and "globby", depending on the method used to preserve it.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: Salt, measured to 20% by weight of the plums

steps.text: Sterilize a jar and utensils with potable alcohol or boiling water.
Remove any damaged plums. Wash the remaining plums, and wipe them dry.
Remove the plum stems and any woody bits, making sure not to damage the fruit.
Cover plums with cold water and let stand overnight.
Drain water and place drained plums in a larger, non-reactive (i.e. glass or ceramic) container.
Evenly layer the salt and plums in the container, making sure the plums are well coated with salt.
Place a non-reactive plate directly on top of plums in their container. Place a weight on top of the plate to weight down the plums—this helps ensure the plums become submerged in brine.
Cover the container with a clean cloth to keep out debris, and place in a cool dark place to pickle.

Check the container after 3 days—pickling liquid should be forming and submerging the plums. There should be no mold growth—if there is a very small amount, you can carefully remove it with clean utensils. It is important to keep the plums fully submerged in the pickling liquid to prevent mold growth and rotting.
Re-weight the plums, and leave to pickle for another 3–4 weeks.

Remove the plums from the pickling liquid, and arrange over a bamboo mat or other woven tray that won't keep the moisture in. Set them outside in hot, dry, sunny weather, and allow them to dry for three full days.
Strain the pickling liquid, and boil it to remove any impurities.
Rub salt into the shiso to remove scum. Squeeze the shiso to remove liquid.
Put the plums, shiso, and boiled liquid back into a clean jar, and store in the fridge.

recipes.notes: The high salt proportion inhibits microbial growth and ensures that the plums pickle properly—don't reduce it. A variety of items can be used to weight down the plums. Examples include a heavy, clean rock; a bottle of water; a bag of pie weights; a heavy crock or pot/pan; etc. The weight should be clean and should not touch the plums directly. Damaged plums can increase the likelihood of mold growth, so it's important not to use them. Adding red shiso leaves to the pickling mixture yields redder plums and a deep red plum vinegar. If you want to do this, measure the shiso leaves to 20% of the weight of the plums. Wash and dry the shiso, then measure out salt to 10% of the shiso weight. Massage the shiso and salt together well for several minutes to release its astringent liquid, then squeeze out the shiso and discard all the liquid. Repeat the salting and massaging process with the same a (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Japanese Potato Salad
recipes.description: Creamy mashed-and-chunky potato salad with cucumber, carrot, egg, and ham dressed in tangy Japanese mayonnaise.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
1/2 small carrot, thinly sliced into quarter moons

steps.text: Place the potatoes in a pot of cold salted water, bring to a boil, and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until tender.
Add the carrot slices for the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Drain well, return the potatoes to the hot pot, and shake over low heat for 1 minute to dry them.
Roughly mash the potatoes, leaving some chunks, and stir in the rice vinegar while still hot; let cool to room temperature.
Toss the cucumber and onion with a pinch of salt, let stand for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the liquid.
Fold the cucumber, onion, carrot, eggs, and ham into the potatoes.
Stir in the mayonnaise, season with salt and pepper, and chill for 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Japanese Souffle Cheesecake
recipes.description: A light, jiggly cotton-soft cheesecake that is baked gently in a water bath.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 320°F (160°C) and line the bottom and sides of an 8-inch round cake pan (not springform) with parchment that extends 2 inches above the rim.
Melt the cream cheese, butter, and milk together in a bowl set over simmering water, whisking until smooth, then let cool slightly.
Whisk in the egg yolks one at a time, then sift in the cake flour and cornstarch and whisk until smooth; stir in the lemon juice.
In a clean bowl, beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar until foamy, then gradually add the sugar and beat to soft-to-medium peaks.
Fold one third of the whites into the yolk mixture to lighten it, then gently fold in the rest until no streaks remain.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and tap it on the counter to release large bubbles.
Set the pan in a larger roasting pan and pour in hot water to come 1 inch up the sides.
Bake for 25 minutes, then reduce the oven to 285°F (140°C) and bake for 45 to 55 minutes more until golden and set.
Turn off the oven and leave the cake inside with the door slightly open for 15 minutes to prevent collapsing.
Remove from the pan, cool, and dust with powdered sugar before serving warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Johnnycakes
recipes.description: Crisp cornmeal griddle cakes descended from the Narragansett and Wampanoag nokehick, the parched-corn cakes shared with early New England settlers.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 tbsp butter or bacon fat, for the griddle

steps.text: Stir the cornmeal, salt, and sugar together in a bowl.
Pour in the boiling water, stirring constantly, until the cornmeal is fully moistened.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes, then thin with enough milk to make a thick, spoonable batter.
Heat the butter on a griddle or cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Drop the batter by heaping tablespoons and flatten slightly into 3-inch cakes.
Cook without moving for 5–6 minutes until a golden crust forms, then flip and cook another 5 minutes.
Serve hot with butter and maple syrup.

recipes.photoCredit: Douglas Perkins / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Johnnycakes.jpg

recipes.title: Jägerschnitzel (Hunter's Schnitzel)
recipes.description: Pan-fried pork cutlets smothered in a creamy mushroom and onion gravy.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin cutlets (about 5 oz each)

steps.text: Pound the cutlets between sheets of plastic wrap to 1/4 inch thick and season with salt and pepper.
Set up three shallow dishes with flour, beaten eggs and breadcrumbs, and dredge each cutlet in the flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the cutlets for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden, then drain and keep warm.
In another skillet, cook the bacon until crisp, then add the butter and onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and their liquid has evaporated.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute, then add the broth and simmer until thickened.
Stir in the cream, simmer for 2 minutes and season with salt, pepper and parsley.
Spoon the sauce over the schnitzel and serve with spaetzle, fries or Bratkartoffeln.

recipes.title: Kabab Barg (Persian Grilled Meat)
recipes.description: This kebab is prepared by marinating meat overnight and grilling it over an open fire. It is usually served with polo (white rice) or naan.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, cut into 1 x 5 cm pieces

steps.text: Combine the olive oil, onions, garlic, saffron, salt, and pepper to make the marinade.
Toss the lamb pieces with the marinade. Cover, and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
Thread the lamb onto metal skewers.
Brush the lamb with the marinade. Grill for 5–10 minutes on each side over an open fire.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kababi_alborz2.jpg

recipes.title: Kartoffelpuffer (Potato Pancakes)
recipes.description: Crisp, lacy fried potato pancakes served with applesauce — a favorite at German Christmas markets and fairs.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and onion on the coarse side of a box grater.
Place the grated mixture in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Transfer to a bowl and mix in the eggs, flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Heat about 1/4 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Drop 1/4-cup portions of the batter into the oil and flatten them into thin 4-inch rounds.
Fry for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden brown and crisp at the edges.
Drain on paper towels and keep warm in a 200°F (95°C) oven while frying the rest, adding oil as needed.
Serve hot with applesauce, or with sour cream and smoked salmon for a savory version.

recipes.photoCredit: Martin van Baal / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Reibekuchen_mit_Apfelmus.jpg

recipes.title: Kartoffelsuppe (German Potato Soup)
recipes.description: A hearty, rustic potato soup with leeks, root vegetables and marjoram, finished with sliced wieners.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 leek, white and light green parts, sliced
1 celery root (about 8 oz), peeled and diced
2 lb starchy potatoes, peeled and diced

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot over medium heat until it renders its fat.
Add the butter, onion and leek and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the carrots, celery root and potatoes and stir for 2 minutes.
