recipes.notes: Times and quantities are rough and can vary to suit individual tastes. The roughing up of the surface of the potatoes is key to a crispy surface—this is the purpose of the shaking, and it can alternatively or additionally be accomplished by scraping the surface of the potatoes with a fork. Compare with forking the top of the mash in shepherd's pie. If initially deep-frying, the fat or oil must be hot before adding the potatoes—they should sizzle when added—or else they will be greasy rather than fluffy and crisp. Some advocate flipping the potatoes half-way through roasting, while others assert that this is unnecessary. You may also wish to carefully baste with oil partway through the roast, to ensure an even coating; again, some find this necessary, while others do not. Potatoes can also be cooked in the same oven and same roasting tin as the meat or other vegetables if being included a (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Roast Turkey with Stuffing
recipes.description: Roast turkey usually forms the centerpiece of Thanksgiving in the United States. There are many recipes and methods for cooking whole turkeys. Below is one of the simplest and therefore one of the most traditional.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried cherries, stemmed and finely chopped
2 1/2 cups shredded cooked chicken or turkey
1 1/2 quarts turkey stock or chicken stock

steps.text: Combine stuffing ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Preheat oven to 325°F. Place the rack in the lowest position of the oven.
Remove the neck and giblets.
Rinse the turkey and pat it dry with paper towels.
Place the turkey, breast side up, on a rack in the roasting pan. Rub the skin with softened butter, and season with salt and pepper.
Fill the body cavity with stuffing.
Place a meat thermometer in the thickest part of one thigh.
Position an aluminum foil tent over the turkey.
Place the turkey in the oven and pour 2 cups of stock into the bottom of the roasting pan.
Roast the turkey for 2 1/2 hours, basting the entire turkey every 30 minutes with the juices on the bottom of the pan. Add stock to the drippings as they become dry, about 1–2 cups at a time.
Remove aluminum foil tent.

Roast until the meat reaches 185°F and the stuffing reaches 165°F. This should take about 4 hours. If the stuffing isn't done by the time the turkey is ready, scoop the stuffing out and bake it alone in the oven until it reaches the correct temperature.
Serve immediately.

recipes.notes: If you can't find pre-made stock in a store then you'll have to make it. You should know, however, turkey stock requires four hours of simmering. So make your stock the day before you make the turkey and stuffing. If you don't have the time to make turkey stock then use pre-made chicken stock which all supermarkets carry. Here's a great recipe for turkey stock from the Food Network. Cooking turkey and stuffing involves the risk of salmonella poisoning. To prevent this, cook the turkey to 185 degrees Fahrenheit and the stuffing to 165 degrees Fahrenheit. Also, avoid cross contamination by keeping raw turkey away from all foods and wash your hands thoroughly after handling it. The most effective way to measure food temperatures is with a digital meat thermometer. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Photo by M. Rehemtulla / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RoastTurkey.jpg

recipes.title: Roasted Pork with Potatoes and Onions (Schweinsbraten)
recipes.description: Schweinsbraten, also called bratl or roast salted pork, is a traditional meal of the Austrian, Bavarian, and even Bohemian cuisine. Nowadays, a Bratl is a dish for social events rather than an everyday meal. Served in a tray as “Bratl in der Rein”, it is often the highlight of social get-togethers. Typical side dishes are “Stöcklkraut” (parboiled and roasted cabbage) and “Knödel” (dumplings).
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 pinch freshly-milled black pepper (or to taste)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 170–190°C.
Wash the meat thoroughly and pat it dry with a paper towel. For a crispy crunch on top of the meat, cut a diamond pattern (each about 1 inch long) into the fat side.
Rub salt, pepper and garlic well into the meat.
Fill a roasting tray with water to a depth of 2 cm and place the meat with the fat side down in it. Sprinkle it with caraway seeds and place onion rings on it.
Wash the peeled potatoes and place them next to the roast. Now roast the meat in the oven at 220°C for about 1 hour.
As soon as the potatoes are soft, take them out of the dish and cover them with foil. Then turn the fat side of the meat up, sprinkle it again with caraway seeds and thinly sliced onions.

Roast it for another 30–45 minutes, basting it frequently with juices from the dish or beer. If there is not enough liquid, you may add water. Only baste with little broth each time. Brush the crispy rind once more with cold beer towards the end of the cooking time. This ensures a crispy crackling.
The meat is done when only juice oozes out (no blood), and the crust should be brown and crunchy.

Deglaze the pan with beer and hot water and season it with salt and pepper. Scrape all browned bits sticking to the pan for a tasty sauce. Cut the meat into thin slices and arrange them with gravy, potatoes, and bread dumplings on a plate.

recipes.notes: The ideal roast gravy is brown and translucent. Don’t thicken it with flour or cornstarch. This is deemed a deadly sin for Bratl-Connoisseurs! To add a wonderful aroma to the gravy, pour some beer over the meat shortly before it is done.
recipes.photoCredit: Austrian delicacy / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Schweinsbraten_on_plate.JPG

recipes.title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
recipes.description: Crunchy, salted pumpkin seeds roasted until golden, a snack enjoyed for generations wherever pumpkins and squash were grown in the Americas.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 cups raw pumpkin seeds, rinsed and dried
1 tbsp sunflower oil or melted butter

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C).
Pick any strings of pumpkin flesh off the seeds and pat them thoroughly dry with a towel.
Toss the seeds with the oil, salt, and chili powder.
Spread them in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, stirring every 8 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Cool completely on the pan before serving.

recipes.photoCredit: Dmitry Makeev / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pepita_de_calabaza.jpg

recipes.title: Rose Hip Tea
recipes.description: A tangy, vitamin-rich tea from wild rose hips, gathered after the first frost and steeped by many Indigenous nations across the north for winter wellness.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried rose hips, lightly crushed, or 1 cup fresh rose hips, halved and seeded
1 to 2 tbsp honey or maple syrup (optional)

steps.text: Place the rose hips and water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10–15 minutes.
Remove from the heat and steep for 5 minutes more.
Strain through a fine sieve lined with cheesecloth to remove the fine hairs.
Sweeten with honey or maple syrup if desired and serve hot.

recipes.title: Rote Grütze (Red Berry Pudding)
recipes.description: A northern German summer dessert of red berries and currants simmered with juice and lightly thickened, served cold with vanilla sauce or cream.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 4 cups mixed red berries (raspberries, red currants, strawberries, cherries), fresh or frozen
1 1/2 cups red berry or cherry juice
1 cup heavy cream or vanilla sauce, for serving

steps.text: Halve any large strawberries and pit the cherries if using fresh.
Whisk 1/4 cup of the juice with the cornstarch until smooth.
Bring the remaining juice and the sugar to a boil in a saucepan.
Add the cornstarch mixture and stir constantly until the juice thickens and turns glossy, about 1 minute.
Stir in the berries, lemon juice and vanilla and simmer for just 1 to 2 minutes so the fruit keeps its shape.
Pour into a serving bowl or individual glasses and let cool, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Serve cold with pouring cream, vanilla sauce or vanilla ice cream.

recipes.photoCredit: Olaf Simons / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rote_Gr%C3%BCtze_mit_Vanilleso%C3%9Fe.JPG

recipes.title: Rotkohl (Braised Red Cabbage)
recipes.description: Sweet-and-sour red cabbage slowly braised with apples, onion and warm spices — the essential side for roasts and holiday dinners.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 medium head red cabbage (about 2 1/2 lb), cored and thinly sliced
2 tart apples, peeled, cored and diced
3 tbsp brown sugar or red currant jelly

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large heavy pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the apples and cook for 2 minutes more.
Add the cabbage, vinegar, water, brown sugar, salt and pepper and toss well.
Tie the bay leaf, cloves and juniper in a piece of cheesecloth, or add them loose, and tuck them into the cabbage.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook over low heat for 1 to 1 1/4 hours, stirring occasionally and adding a splash of water if it gets dry.
Remove the spices and adjust the balance of sugar, vinegar and salt to taste.
Serve hot with roast pork, sauerbraten, duck or goose; it tastes even better reheated the next day.

recipes.title: S'mores
recipes.description: S'mores are a traditional American campfire treat, prepared over an open fire or even in your own home.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 4 graham crackers (4 x 2 in / 10 x 5 cm)

steps.text: Outdoors: Build a campfire for toasting the marshmallows.

Find a long, thin stick for roasting (a thin, long wooden dowel may be a good substitute but will catch fire easily). The stick, which is usually taken from the ground as part of a dead tree branch, does not have to be sterilized, but simply clear of any dirt or bark. Alternately, you may purchase a metal roaster stick. Don't use a coat hanger or chrome or galvanized metal (like fence wire)—use stainless steel.
Before roasting the marshmallows, break the crackers in half, so you have two 2 x 2 inch (5 x 5 cm) squares for each s'more. Break the chocolate bar into 1/2 oz (15 g) pieces.

Push a marshmallow on to the end of the stick. Using the stick to place the marshmallow directly above the flame or source of heat, toast the marshmallow until it is golden brown around the outside. Some prefer their marshmallow burned. Others like to burn the marshmallow and peel off the burned outer skin to get to the gooey center.

Place the toasted marshmallow in between two pieces of graham cracker, with a layer of chocolate bar in between. The marshmallow should be hot enough to melt the chocolate. In a family setting, sometimes it is helpful for children to roast the marshmallows, and adults to supervise and assemble the s'more while preventing the child from touching the hot end of the stick. Enjoy!
Indoors: Prepare the pieces of graham cracker and chocolate as above.
Place the chocolate on one of the pieces of graham cracker, and then place a marshmallow on top.
Put it in the microwave for 15–25 seconds (depending on the microwave).

After it has been microwaved, the marshmallow should be much bigger, fluffier, and molten, and the chocolate should be semi-melted. Place the other half of the graham cracker on top of the marshmallow and squish it down.

recipes.notes: 70 variations on the basic s'more recipe were published in 2007 in S'mores: Gourmet Treats for Every Occasion by Lisa Adams. If you are not camping, patio/backyard firepits work great. Milk chocolate 1 graham cracker, broken in half Fresh blueberries 1 marshmallow 1 thick strawberry slice (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Sagamité (Maple Hominy Porridge)
recipes.description: A Great Lakes porridge of cracked hominy or cornmeal sweetened with maple sugar and enriched with sunflower seeds, eaten for centuries by Algonquian and Haudenosaunee peoples.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup coarse hominy grits or stone-ground cornmeal
1/4 cup maple syrup or 3 tbsp maple sugar

steps.text: Bring the water and salt to a boil in a heavy saucepan.
Slowly whisk in the hominy grits or cornmeal.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring often, for 20–25 minutes until thick and tender.
Stir in the maple syrup and dried berries and cook 3 minutes more.
Spoon into bowls and top with sunflower seeds.

recipes.title: Salsa (recipe)
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 can (14–16 oz) of peeled, diced tomatoes
1 bunch of fresh cilantro (aka coriander leaf, Mexican parsley)
3–6 fresh serrano chili peppers (the more the spicier; start with 3)
1 pinch of pepper and/or garlic to taste (optional)

steps.text: Add onion to blender.
Wash and chop the cilantro, removing only the very bottom of the stem. Add to blender.
Wash and chop the chile peppers, then add to blender.
Open the canned tomatoes, add to blender.
Add the salt.
Blend slowly, to thoroughly mix ingredients; do not completely blend.
Serve chilled, with a meal, as a dip for corn tortilla chips, as a garnish, etc.

recipes.notes: Can be easily stored in a closed container in refrigerator for a week or ten days. Be very careful not to touch your eyes, nose, or mouth after chopping or handling the chili peppers, the pain can be intense. Wash your hands thoroughly after handling. (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Popo le Chien / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Various_salsas.jpg

recipes.title: Salsa Verde (Roasted Tomatillo Salsa)
recipes.description: A bright, tangy green salsa of charred tomatillos, serrano chiles, garlic, and cilantro for tacos, chips, and enchiladas.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1/2 cup cilantro leaves and tender stems

steps.text: Heat the broiler with a rack 4 inches from the element.
Spread the tomatillos, chiles, onion, and garlic on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Broil for 5–7 minutes, turn everything over, and broil 4–5 minutes more until charred and soft.
Peel the garlic and stem the chiles once cool enough to handle.
Blend everything, including the tomatillo juices, with the cilantro and salt to a slightly chunky purée.
Stir in the lime juice, taste for salt, and let cool before serving.

recipes.title: Salted Mustard Greens and Shredded Meat Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Salted mustard greens and shredded meat noodle soup (雪菜肉絲麵) is a Chinese dish composed of salted mustard greens (雪裡紅), shredded pork (肉絲), soup stock, and noodles. Many Chinese restaurants in the US serve this dish. All quantities are approximate.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Wash and dry the mustard greens.
Add salt to the greens.
Seal in a plastic bag and store in the refrigerator for several days.
Cut the pork tenderloin meat into tiny strips. Marinate the meat with corn starch, soy sauce, and sugar.
Retrieve the semi-pickled mustard greens and dice them.
Using a wok, stir-fry the meat until it is slightly brown. Remove the meat from the wok.
Stir-fry the salted mustard greens until slightly brown.
Place the meat back into the wok and add soup stock and water. Simmer for a couple of minutes.
Serve the soup with noodles.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: The original uploader was Hykw-a4 at Japanese Wikipedia. / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nabeyaku_ramen_(cropped).jpg

recipes.title: Sambar II (Kerala/Tamil style)
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (small onions, tomato, drumstick)
Coriander leaves and curry leaves for garnishing, finely chopped

steps.text: Wash and cook the dal until soft. Mash it.
Heat the pan and add 1 tsp oil. Add asafoetida, chili powder, coriander powder, and coriander seeds. Fry them well.
Add coconut and fry until the mixture is dark red in colour (do not burn it). Remove from heat and let cool.
Wash the vegetables, and boil them in a pot of water with the turmeric powder.
When the vegetables are almost done, add tamarind paste and allow it to boil for some time.
Grind the coconut mixture, then mix in the mashed dal. Stir this combination into the pot of vegetables, and let it boil for some time.
Season with salt to taste, and mix in the mustard seed and curry leaves.
Serve hot, garnished with the coriander leaves.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Kalaiselvi Murugesan / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pumpkin_sambar.JPG

recipes.title: Samosa
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Steam the potatoes and peas separately. Cut the potatoes into small pieces.
Heat a dash of olive oil in a frying pan. Add onions and chilis, and sauté until the onions turn transparent.
Add the potatoes, peas, and spices. Sauté them while stirring until they are completely cooked.
Add mint leaves, and coriander leaves.
Mix the flour with enough water to make a stiff dough. Knead in 1 tablespoon of oil and a pinch of table salt. Knead it well.
Roll dough into even-sized balls (about 3.5 cm in diameter) and roll them out into circles using a rolling pin.
Cut each circle in half to make semi-circles.
Place a spoonful of the vegetable mixture onto the dough semi-circles, and fold on three sides to make each one into a pyramid shape.
Deep fry the samosas until golden and crispy.

recipes.notes: Multiple variations are possible for filling. Lamb and other meats work well with samosa, as do peppers, rice, paneer and mince (keema). (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Sauerbraten
recipes.description: Germany's famous sweet-and-sour pot roast: beef marinated for several days in spiced vinegar and wine, then braised and served with a gingersnap gravy.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3 1/2 lb beef bottom round or chuck roast

steps.text: Combine the vinegar, wine, water, onion, carrot, bay leaves, peppercorns, cloves, juniper, sugar and salt in a saucepan and bring to a boil, then let cool completely.
Place the beef in a deep glass or ceramic dish or zip-top bag, pour the cooled marinade over it, cover and refrigerate for 3 to 5 days, turning the meat once a day.
Remove the beef from the marinade, pat it dry with paper towels, and strain the marinade, reserving both the liquid and the vegetables.
Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef well on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Add the reserved vegetables and 2 cups of the strained marinade, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook over low heat (or in a 325°F (165°C) oven) for 3 to 3 1/2 hours until very tender.
Transfer the meat to a cutting board and tent it with foil to rest.
Strain the cooking liquid into a saucepan, pressing on the vegetables, and add water or more marinade to make about 2 1/2 cups.
Bring the liquid to a simmer and whisk in the gingersnaps, brown sugar and raisins, cooking for 5 to 8 minutes until the gravy is smooth and thickened.
Slice the beef against the grain and serve with the gravy, red cabbage and potato dumplings or spaetzle.

recipes.photoCredit: Dr. Bernd Gross / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Heldrunger_Sauerbraten_2.JPG

recipes.title: Sauerkraut I
recipes.description: Sauerkraut is a traditional fermented vegetable food made from cabbage. This basic recipe produces a tangy sauerkraut with live bacteria. No cooking is required.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Clean and dry a large (3 litres) preserves jar or crock, chopping board, and large bowls if needed.
Quarter the cabbage and remove the core.
Slice the cabbage finely or thickly, as you prefer.
If desired, bruise the sliced cabbage by beating with a rolling pin or mortar and pestle.
Layer the cabbage in the jar or crock, sprinkling salt in between the layers.
Pack tightly into the jar, leaving 1 cm space at the top; don't seal the jar yet.
Juice should rise to top of jar as you tightly pack the cabbage in; if not, add a little chlorine-free water.

Cover the jar with a clean cloth or cling-wrap. Set the jar in a bowl or on a plate, so that any juice that might overflow will be collected and won't make a mess. Don't seal the jar while it is fermenting, as it will build up gas pressure and might break the jar.

Every morning and evening, insert a narrow long object into the jar to let the air out, then collect the juice from the plate and re-add it to the jar. Ensure the temperature is kept constant during the fermentation—otherwise the fermentation may not proceed correctly, and the wrong bacteria may grow. If you don't heat your kitchen in winter then you will need to store the jar in your bedroom or another area with a steadier temperature throughout day and night.

The sauerkraut will be fermented in three days to about a week. Wipe any excess liquid from around the jar, and put the lid on tightly before moving it to a cool place (e.g. the refrigerator) to mature. It is ready to eat after the first week, but it will improve with age as the bacteria slowly consume the more complex sugars in the cabbage.

recipes.notes: The salt used should be non-iodised, since iodine can slightly inhibit the fermentation. Use what you've got, but best results will be obtained without the iodine. Add other vegetables, fruits, or spices such as juniper berries, cored and sliced apple, diced pineapple, onion, chili, or grated carrot. The cabbage can be quickly sliced to a regular thickness by using a mandoline. (Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Sautéed Fiddleheads
recipes.description: Tender coiled ostrich-fern shoots, a spring delicacy gathered by the Wolastoqiyik (Maliseet) and Mi'kmaq of the Maritimes and Maine, sautéed with wild garlic.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 tbsp salt, for the cooking water
2 cloves garlic or 4 ramps, thinly sliced
1 tsp lemon juice or apple cider vinegar

steps.text: Trim the brown ends from the fiddleheads and rub off any papery brown scales.
Wash them in several changes of cold water.
Boil in salted water for 10–12 minutes until tender (fiddleheads should always be fully cooked), then drain.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the garlic or ramps for 1 minute.
Add the fiddleheads and cook for 3–4 minutes, tossing, until lightly browned.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice and serve hot.

recipes.title: Scallion Pancakes
recipes.description: Flaky, chewy pan-fried flatbreads layered with sesame oil and green onions, served with a soy dipping sauce.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Place the flour in a bowl, pour in the boiling water while stirring with chopsticks, then add the cold water and mix into a shaggy dough.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth, then cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 pieces and roll one piece into a thin 8-inch circle.
Brush the circle with sesame oil, sprinkle with a pinch of salt and a quarter of the green onions.
Roll the circle up tightly like a cigar, then coil the rope into a spiral and tuck the end underneath.
Flatten the spiral and gently roll it out into a 7-inch pancake; repeat with the remaining dough.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook a pancake for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Squeeze the hot pancake from the sides with two spatulas to fluff up the layers, then repeat with the rest.
Mix the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and chili oil for dipping, cut the pancakes into wedges, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Scottish Porridge
recipes.description: Scottish Porridge is a beloved traditional breakfast dish from Scotland. Traditionally, it doesn't use dairy and only consists of three ingredients - oats, salt and water. This recipe follows the golden ratio of one parts oats to three parts water and uses an overnight pre-soaking method for steel-cut oats. The soaking helps reduce cooking time and the oats are later simmered slowly.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1/2 cup (80 g) steel-cut oats, also called Irish oats
1 teaspoon lemon juice or apple cider vinegar (for soaking)
1 teaspoon of buckwheat flour (for reducing phytates)

steps.text: Mix the steel-cut oats with a teaspoon of buckwheat flour in a bowl.
Add warm water to soak the oats and add a splash of lemon juice or apple cider vinegar. Cover and allow to soak overnight or at least 7 to 8 hours.
Place the oats, salt and water into a small pan and gently bring it to a small boil, stirring occasionally until the porridge starts to thicken.

Once the thickening has begun, lower the heat to low to avoid burning the porridge and allow it to simmer for approximately 15 to 20 minutes (or less if the oats are tender and reached your preferred consistency).
Remove from the heat and let it stand for 1 or 2 minutes before serving.
Serve and top with your choice of toppings, such as chia seeds, walnuts, tablespoon of peanut butter, berries, cinnamon, or a dollop of Greek yogurt.

recipes.notes: Traditionalists uses whole-oat groats and mill them to make Scottish porridge. However store bought steel-cut oats are a reliable substitute for those who do not possess a mill. If you possess a mill and desire the authentic Scottish taste, you can swap steel-cut oats and use milled whole-oat groats instead. Pre-soaking is essential to achieve a soft, velvety texture as it helps break down starches in oats and soften its hearty outer hull. To reduce phytates in oats, you should add both an acidic medium and a phytase-rich ingredient to your soaking liquid, This can be achieved by adding a teaspoon of buckwheat flour and a teaspoon of apple cider vinegar. Ideally you should start your soak with warm water (but not boiling as that kills enzymes) and leave it out to soak at room temperature for 16 to 24 hours. However, a shorter 8 to 12 hours can still significantly reduce anti-nutrients an
recipes.photoCredit: Renee Comet (Photographer) / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Oatmeal_(1).jpg

recipes.title: Seafood Gumbo
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 lb Andouille sausage, cut in pieces

steps.text: Heat oil in a 6–8 quart pot, then gradually whisk in the flour. Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes until very dark reddish brown. Stir constantly, especially towards the end. The best roux is quite dark, but don’t let it burn.
Stir the onion, celery, bell pepper, and garlic into the roux. Cook 10 minutes (or 15 minutes if using okra).
Slowly and gradually whisk in the shrimp stock.
Add the clam juice, oregano, thyme, bay leaves, salt, cayenne, pepper, and parsley. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the Andouille sausage, and simmer for another 30–40 minutes.
Add the shrimp, oysters, and crawfish at the end, and simmer just until cooked through.
Top with chopped green onions.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Prince Roy / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Seafood_Gumbo!_Drago%27s,_Metairie_Louisiana.jpg

recipes.title: Semmelknoedel (Bavarian Bread Dumplings)
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 10 white bread rolls, cut into small cubes
1 bunch of parsley, washed and chopped

steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the diced onions, and sauté until translucent. Remove from the heat.
Combine the bread cubes and the cooked onions.
Mix the eggs with the milk, and pour it over the bread and the onions. Mix to make a dough.
Mix the parsley and flour into the dough. Season with salt and pepper.
Form balls of the dough about the size of tennis balls.
Boil the knoedel in salted water. After about 2 minutes, turn the temperature down to a lower setting and let them boil for another 10–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sesame Balls (Jian Dui)
recipes.description: Crisp, hollow glutinous rice balls coated in sesame seeds and filled with sweet red bean paste.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Dissolve the brown sugar in the hot water.
Gradually stir the sugar water into the rice flour, then knead into a smooth, soft dough like play clay, adding a little more water or flour as needed.
Divide the dough into 16 pieces and the red bean paste into 16 small balls.
Flatten each piece of dough into a cup, place a ball of bean paste in the center, and pinch closed, rolling it into a smooth ball.
Dip each ball briefly in water and roll it in the sesame seeds, pressing gently so they stick.
Heat the oil in a deep pot to 320°F (160°C).
Fry the balls in batches for 8 to 10 minutes, gently pressing them against the side of the pot with a ladle as they float so they puff and expand.
Remove when golden brown and drain on paper towels; serve warm.

recipes.photoCredit: Jerryfredloawm Howoard / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HK_KTD_%E8%A7%80%E5%A1%98%E9%81%93_414_Kwun_Tong_Road_One_Pacific_Centre_shop_%E6%B5%B7%E6%B8%AF%E9%85%92%E5%AE%B6_Victoria_Harbour_Restaurant_food_dim_sum_%E7%85%8E%E5%A0%86_sesame_ball_%E9%A3%B2%E8%8C%B6_morning_tea_April_2023_Px3_02.jpg

recipes.title: Sesame Shrimp Toast
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 3 slices (or more as needed) sandwich bread

steps.text: Remove shells and tails from shrimp. Remove back veins from shrimp. Cut down back of shrimp with sharp knife. Chop shrimp into a very small dice.
Beat 1 egg, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and finely-chopped green onions in a small bowl until blended.
Add shrimp to egg mixture, and toss until shrimp are completely coated.
Remove crusts from bread. Cut each slice into quarters.
Place one spoonful of shrimp mixture on each piece of bread. Gently press to adhere to bread.
Brush or rub small amount of egg mixture over each shrimp toast.
Dip moist side into the sesame seeds spread out on a plate.
Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 375°F (190°C).
Fry 3–4 shrimp toast pieces at a time in the hot oil until golden, 1–2 minutes on each side. Drain on absorbent paper.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Shashlik (Russian Skewered Meat)
recipes.description: Shashlik (Russian шашлык from Turkic shishlik < shish "rod, skewer") is a dish of usually mostly meat roasted over open fire on skewers. Russians seem to have borrowed making shashliks from peoples of Caucasus mountains, and shashliks have become a picnic/garden party food in Russia similar to barbecue elsewhere.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: Pieces of onion, red or green bell pepper, bacon, sausage, cucumber, baby mushrooms

steps.text: Mix the honey, mustard, vodka, salt and pepper in a deep bowl and soak the meat pieces in it. Leave the bowl in the refrigerator for 3 hours.
Arrange the meat pieces on wooden or metal skewers, putting some pieces of bacon, sausage, pepper, onion, mushrooms, cucumber, according to your preference, between the pieces of meat.
Grill the skewers.
Serve with potato and other salads! Enjoy!

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie I
recipes.description: Cottage pie, or shepherd's pie, is a meat pie with a mashed potato top. It is traditionally made with leftover roast meat, but today it is more often made with fresh minced meat.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) minced or ground lamb or beef
3 lb (1.3 kg) powdery old potatoes, such as King Edwards
2 cups (300 ml) beef stock (alternatively, bouillon cubes can be used, or gravy powder, if the flour is omitted)
1 handful of mixed vegetables such as sweetcorn or carrots (optional)

steps.text: Heat oil in a pan and brown the mince. Where lean meat is used, there may be no need to use additional oil.
Finely chop the onion and lightly fry in a little butter with a small amount of salt until clear.
Add the onions to the mince, mixed herbs, and some pepper.
Sprinkle the flour over the mixture, stir, and cook for 3–4 minutes (if using gravy powder, omit this step).
Cover with lamb or beef stock (or add water and beef bouillon/gravy powder) and simmer for 30 minutes.
Test the savoury mince for seasoning. If gravy is not used, additional salt may be needed.

Meanwhile: Peel, chop and boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until cooked. Once the meat is cooked, skim off the excess fat, then reduce the savoury mince until the liquid is level with the mince and onions. Drain the potatoes until completely dry. Mash until smooth and free of any lumps. Add butter to the mashed potato, taste and add seasoning as required. Slowly add milk whilst mashing until the mash is soft and creamy (heavy mash will not float properly on top of the mince).
Put mince mixture in a shallow oven-proof dish.
Layer the mash over the meat and brush the tops of the potatoes with melted butter.
If desired, sprinkle the grated cheese on top of the mash.
If cooking without cheese, rough up the surface of the mash by dragging a fork across it, as if ploughing a field.
Bake in a hot oven for about 30–50 minutes until the top is golden brown.
Serve with peas or beans, or other green vegetables.

recipes.notes: The terms are often used interchangeably, regardless of meat, though many cookbooks refer to "shepherd's pie" if made with lamb, and "cottage pie" if made with beef, or highlight the possible variations within a single recipe. Adding the butter and milk to the potatoes before they are properly mashed is the best way to make lumpy mash. Roughing up the surface of the mash makes the top crisper, by increasing the surface area and providing thin sections which dry out and crisp faster; compare roast potatoes. Frying the meat in lard can improve the texture and consistency of the finished product, although this also has the effect of increasing drastically the saturated fat content. As with many dishes based on minced meat, the mince can be cooked for much longer in the stock than specified, up to two hours. Some cooks prefer this as it gives longer for the flavour to develop. People often c (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: Samuel Engelking / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shepherds_Pie.jpg

recipes.title: Shokupan (Japanese Milk Bread)
recipes.description: A tall, fluffy, slightly sweet white sandwich loaf made extra soft with a cooked flour paste called tangzhong.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Whisk the 3 tbsp flour and 1/2 cup milk in a small saucepan over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until it thickens to a paste, then let it cool.
Combine the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a stand mixer bowl.
Add the warm milk, egg, and cooled tangzhong and knead with the dough hook on low for 5 minutes.
Add the softened butter and knead on medium for 10 to 12 minutes until the dough is smooth, elastic, and passes the windowpane test.
Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled.
Punch down the dough, divide it into 3 equal pieces, and roll each into an oval, fold in the sides, and roll up tightly.
Place the rolls seam side down in a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan, cover, and let rise for 45 to 60 minutes until the dough reaches the rim.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Brush the top with milk and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until deep golden and the internal temperature reaches 190°F (88°C).
Turn out onto a rack and cool completely before slicing.

recipes.photoCredit: 午後紅茶 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shokupan.jpg

recipes.title: Shortbread
recipes.description: Shortbread is a type of cookie which is traditionally made from one part white sugar, two parts butter, and three parts plain white flour, although other ingredients like ground rice or cornstarch are sometimes added to alter the texture. Shortbread is so named because of its crumbly texture (from an old meaning of the word short). The cause of this texture is its high fat content, provided by the butter.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 110 g (1/2 cup / 4 oz) white granulated sugar

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 140°C (275°F or Gas Mark 1).
Cream the butter with the sugar until light and fluffy.
Sift the flour and salt into the mixture and work into the fat and sugar until completely amalgamated.
Shape the dough into a ball and roll out to about 1.3 cm (1/2 inch) thick. The dough may need to be chilled for 10–15 minutes for easier handling.
Cut into squares or rectangles and prick the tops with a fork in two parallel lines.
Bake in the oven for 30–40 minutes or until the shortbread is lightly browned.
Leave them on a cooling rack to cool.
Store in a cool place in an airtight container.

recipes.notes: Some recipes call for a 1-2-3 ratio of sugar, fat, and flour, but fat is often increased to prevent dryness. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)
recipes.photoCredit: User:Dave souza / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.5 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shortbread_fingers.jpg

recipes.title: Sichuan Dry-Fried Green Beans
recipes.description: Green beans fried until blistered and wrinkled, then tossed with savory pork, garlic, and chilies.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed and dried well
6 dried red chilies, snipped into pieces

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat and add the green beans.
Fry for 8 to 10 minutes, tossing occasionally, until the beans are blistered, wrinkled, and tender; transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the wok and stir-fry the pork for 2 to 3 minutes until browned and crisp.
Add the dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant without burning.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 20 seconds.
Return the green beans to the wok and add the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, and salt.
Toss for 1 minute until everything is well coated, then serve hot.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.description: Sloppy joes are loosemeat sandwiches that have roots in the cuisine of the Midwestern United States.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.

steps.text: Brown the ground beef, onions, and peppers in skillet on medium heat.
Drain the liquid from the mixture.
Place the ground beef back on the skillet.
While on medium heat mix in the ketchup, barbecue sauce, garlic powder, and chili powder in any order.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve over sliced, toasted hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Apple Butter
recipes.description: Smooth, deeply spiced apple butter made by cooking apples down overnight in the slow cooker — no constant stirring required.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 5 lb apples (a mix such as Gala, Fuji and Granny Smith), peeled, cored and sliced

steps.text: Place the apples in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Mix the sugars, spices and salt, sprinkle over the apples, add the vinegar, and toss to coat.
Cover and cook on LOW for 10 hours, stirring once or twice if you can, until the apples are very dark and soft.
Stir in the vanilla and purée the mixture until smooth with an immersion blender.
Cook uncovered on LOW for 1 to 2 hours more, stirring occasionally, until thick enough to hold its shape on a spoon.
Spoon into clean jars, let cool, and refrigerate for up to 3 weeks or freeze for up to 1 year.
Serve on toast, biscuits or with pork chops (makes about 6 cups; 1 serving is 2 tablespoons).

recipes.photoCredit: Man vyi / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Beurr%C3%A9e_d%27ni%C3%A8r_beurre_black_butter_on_bread.jpg

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Baby Back Ribs
recipes.description: Yes, the sauce isn't tomato based, but unless you want it to taste like a stew, stay with vinegar based.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds cut-up baby back pork ribs

steps.text: Season ribs liberally with rib rub. Refrigerate overnight.
The next day, combine remaining ingredients. Place ribs in the bottom of a slow cooker and pour mixture over.
Cover and cook on low for 8–9 hours, or until ribs are tender. Serve warm.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: Gunawan Kartapranata / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Balinese_Roasted_Pork_Ribs_-_Iga_Babi_Panggang_Bali.JPG

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef and Bean Chili
recipes.description: A thick, hearty beef chili with two kinds of beans that simmers all day for deep flavor.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes with green chiles
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz) pinto beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Brown the ground beef with the onion and bell pepper in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up the meat, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, oregano and paprika and cook 1 minute until fragrant, then drain off excess fat.
Transfer the mixture to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, beans, broth, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours.
Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding a pinch of cayenne for more heat.
Ladle into bowls and top with cheddar, sour cream and green onions.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Takeout-style beef and broccoli with a savory soy-garlic sauce, made easy in the slow cooker.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb flank steak or chuck, thinly sliced against the grain
3 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp cold water
3 cups cooked white rice, for serving

steps.text: Place the sliced beef in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker.
Whisk together the broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger and pour over the beef.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours or on HIGH for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until the beef is tender.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and add the broccoli.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes until the sauce thickens and the broccoli is crisp-tender.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Barbacoa
recipes.description: Mexican-style shredded beef braised with chipotles, garlic, lime and spices until tender, for tacos, burritos and bowls.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3 lb beef chuck roast, cut into 4 pieces
3 chipotle peppers in adobo, plus 2 tbsp adobo sauce

steps.text: Season the beef all over with salt and pepper and place it in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Blend the onion, garlic, chipotles with adobo sauce, lime juice, vinegar, broth, cumin, oregano and cloves until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the beef and tuck in the bay leaves.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 to 10 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the beef shreds easily.
Remove the bay leaves, shred the beef with two forks right in the slow cooker, and stir it into the juices.
Let it soak in the juices on WARM for 10 minutes, then taste for salt.
Serve in warm tortillas topped with cilantro and onion, or over rice for burrito bowls.

recipes.photoCredit: Elton Rodriguez / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barbacoa_(en_Hidalgo).JPG

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Stroganoff
recipes.description: Tender strips of beef and mushrooms in a creamy, tangy sauce, served over buttered egg noodles.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb beef chuck roast, cut into thin strips
12 oz egg noodles, cooked and buttered

steps.text: Toss the beef with the salt, pepper and flour.
Place the onion, mushrooms and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker and add the beef on top.
Whisk the broth, Worcestershire, mustard and paprika and pour over the beef.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 to 5 hours until the beef is tender.
Stir in the cream cheese until melted, then stir in the sour cream.
Cover and cook on LOW for 10 minutes more until heated through.
Serve over hot buttered egg noodles and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Black-Eyed Peas with Ham
recipes.description: Southern black-eyed peas simmered with smoked ham and spices, eaten on New Year's Day for good luck.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas, rinsed and picked over
1 smoked ham hock or 1 1/2 cups diced ham
1 tsp hot sauce, or to taste
4 cups cooked white rice, for serving

steps.text: Place the black-eyed peas in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the ham hock, onion, bell pepper, celery and garlic.
Pour in the broth and add the bay leaf, thyme, paprika, cayenne and black pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 to 5 hours until the peas are tender.
Remove the ham hock, chop the meat and return it to the pot, discarding the bone and bay leaf.
Season with salt to taste and serve over rice with hot sauce and cornbread.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Bolognese Sauce
recipes.description: A rich, meaty Italian ragù that simmers gently for hours, perfect for pasta or lasagna.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry red or white wine
1/2 cup whole milk or heavy cream

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 to 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef and pork and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Pour in the wine and simmer for 2 minutes, scraping the pan, then transfer everything to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, bay leaf, oregano, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours.
Remove the bay leaf, stir in the milk and cook uncovered on HIGH for 20 minutes to thicken slightly.
Toss with cooked pasta and serve topped with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Braised Short Ribs
recipes.description: Meltingly tender beef short ribs braised in red wine with garlic and herbs, finished in a glossy sauce.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water

steps.text: Season the short ribs with salt and pepper and brown them in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, in batches, about 8 minutes per batch.
Transfer the ribs to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat, add the onion, carrots and celery to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the wine and simmer for 3 minutes, scraping up the browned bits, then pour over the ribs.
Add the broth, vinegar, thyme, rosemary and bay leaves.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the meat is falling off the bone.
Transfer the ribs to a platter, strain and skim the fat from the liquid, then boil it in a saucepan and whisk in the cornstarch slurry until glossy.
Spoon the sauce over the short ribs and serve with mashed potatoes or polenta.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Breakfast Casserole
recipes.description: A hearty hash brown, sausage, egg and cheese casserole that cooks overnight for holiday mornings and brunches.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 bag (30 oz) frozen shredded hash browns, partially thawed

steps.text: Brown the sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, then drain it on paper towels.
Grease a 6-quart slow cooker well.
Layer one third of the hash browns, then one third each of the sausage, onion, bell pepper and cheese; repeat twice more.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, pepper, dry mustard and garlic powder and pour evenly over the layers.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the eggs are set in the center.
Sprinkle with green onions, cut into squares and serve with salsa or hot sauce.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Brown Sugar Glazed Ham
recipes.description: A spiral-cut ham glazed with brown sugar, honey and Dijon, slow cooked to stay moist and free up the oven.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 fully cooked bone-in spiral-cut ham (7 to 8 lb)

steps.text: Place the ham cut side down in a 6- or 7-quart oval slow cooker, trimming it if needed so the lid closes.
Stir together the brown sugar, honey, juice, mustard, cinnamon and cloves.
Spread about two thirds of the glaze over the ham and between the slices.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours until heated through to 140°F (60°C).
Brush the ham with the remaining glaze and the juices in the pot halfway through and again at the end.
Transfer to a platter, spoon the pan juices over the slices, and serve.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken Dip
recipes.description: A creamy, spicy hot dip of shredded chicken, cream cheese, ranch and hot sauce, served warm from the slow cooker.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1/2 cup ranch or blue cheese dressing
4 cups tortilla chips, celery sticks or crackers, for serving

steps.text: Place the chicken, cream cheese, dressing, hot sauce and 1 cup of the cheddar in a 3- to 4-quart slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 2 to 3 hours or on HIGH for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring once or twice, until hot and melted.
Stir well, then sprinkle with the remaining cheddar and the blue cheese.
Cover and cook 10 minutes more until the cheese on top melts.
Garnish with green onions and keep on WARM for serving with chips, celery and crackers.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Butter Chicken
recipes.description: A mild, creamy Indian-style tomato curry with tender chicken, rich with butter, garam masala and cream.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
4 cups cooked basmati rice, for serving

steps.text: Place the chicken, onion, garlic and ginger in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Stir together the tomato sauce, tomato paste, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, paprika, chili powder and salt and pour over the chicken.
Dot the top with the butter.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours until the chicken is cooked through and tender.
Whisk the cream and yogurt together and stir into the curry.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 15 to 20 minutes more until heated through.
Taste for salt, sprinkle with cilantro, and serve over basmati rice with naan.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Comforting homemade chicken noodle soup with tender vegetables and egg noodles, slow cooked from raw chicken.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps.text: Place the chicken, onion, carrots, celery and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the broth, bay leaves, thyme, rosemary, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 to 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the chicken is tender.
Remove the chicken and shred it with two forks, then discard the bay leaves.
Stir in the egg noodles, cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken to the pot and stir in the parsley and lemon juice.
Taste for salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chocolate Lava Cake
recipes.description: A gooey chocolate pudding cake that forms its own rich fudge sauce underneath as it cooks in the slow cooker.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 cups vanilla ice cream, for serving

steps.text: Grease the insert of a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker.
Whisk the flour, sugar, 1/4 cup cocoa, baking powder and salt in a bowl, then stir in the milk, melted butter and vanilla to make a thick batter.
Fold in the chocolate chips and spread the batter evenly in the slow cooker.
Mix the brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa and sprinkle it evenly over the batter.
Pour the hot water gently over the top; do not stir.
Place a clean kitchen towel under the lid to catch condensation, cover, and cook on HIGH for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until the top is set but the edges are bubbly.
Turn off the slow cooker and let stand for 15 minutes, then scoop into bowls, spooning the sauce from the bottom over the cake, and serve with ice cream.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Cinnamon Apples
recipes.description: Tender, buttery cinnamon apples that make a warm side dish or a topping for ice cream, oatmeal or pancakes.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 6 large apples (such as Honeycrisp or Gala), peeled, cored and sliced

steps.text: Toss the apples with the lemon juice in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker.
Mix the sugars, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and cornstarch and sprinkle over the apples, then toss to coat.
Scatter the butter over the top.
Cover and cook on LOW for 3 to 4 hours or on HIGH for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring once halfway, until the apples are tender but not mushy.
Stir in the vanilla.
Serve warm as a side with pork, or spoon over vanilla ice cream, oatmeal or pancakes.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Corned Beef and Cabbage
recipes.description: Spiced corned beef simmered with potatoes, carrots and cabbage for an easy St. Patrick's Day feast.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb corned beef brisket with spice packet
1 bottle (12 oz) Irish stout or 1 1/2 cups beef broth
1 small head green cabbage, cut into 8 wedges

steps.text: Rinse the corned beef and pat it dry.
Place the potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker.
Set the corned beef fat side up on the vegetables and sprinkle with the spice packet.
Pour the stout and water over the top.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 to 9 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the beef is fork-tender.
Add the cabbage wedges around the beef, cover and cook on HIGH for 45 minutes to 1 hour until tender.
Transfer the beef to a cutting board, rest 10 minutes, and slice thinly against the grain.
Toss the vegetables with butter and parsley and serve with the beef and grainy mustard.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Creamy garlic mashed potatoes cooked and mashed right in the slow cooker, freeing up the stovetop for holiday meals.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 5 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks
1 cup sour cream or heavy cream, warmed

steps.text: Place the potatoes and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Pour the broth over the potatoes and sprinkle with the salt.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 4 hours or on LOW for 7 to 8 hours until the potatoes are very tender.
Add the butter, sour cream, cream cheese and pepper and mash with a potato masher until smooth.
Add a splash of warm milk if they are too thick and taste for salt.
Keep warm on the WARM setting for up to 2 hours and sprinkle with chives before serving.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Herb Turkey Breast
recipes.description: A juicy bone-in turkey breast rubbed with garlic herb butter and cooked in the slow cooker — ideal for small Thanksgiving gatherings.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 bone-in, skin-on turkey breast (6 to 7 lb), thawed
2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water

steps.text: Mix the butter, garlic, rosemary, thyme, sage, salt and pepper.
Loosen the skin of the turkey breast and rub half of the herb butter underneath it and the rest over the outside.
Place the onion and celery in a 6- or 7-quart slow cooker, pour in the broth, and set the turkey on top, skin side up.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C).
For crisp skin, transfer the turkey to a baking sheet and broil for 3 to 5 minutes until golden, then rest for 15 minutes.
Strain the cooking juices into a saucepan, bring to a boil, and whisk in the cornstarch slurry to make gravy.
Slice the turkey and serve with the gravy.

recipes.photoCredit: Cooking With Lon / Flickr, CC BY 2.0 — https://www.flickr.com/photos/47123049@N07/4538108921

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken thighs braised in a sweet and savory honey, soy and garlic sauce, thickened into a sticky glaze.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp cold water

steps.text: Arrange the chicken thighs in a single layer in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Whisk together the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic, ginger, vinegar, sesame oil and red pepper flakes and pour over the chicken.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and is tender.
Transfer the chicken to a plate.
Stir the cornstarch slurry into the sauce, cover and cook on HIGH for 15 minutes until thickened.
Return the chicken to the sauce, turning to coat.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions and serve over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Hot Cocoa
recipes.description: Rich, creamy hot chocolate made in the slow cooker and kept warm for a crowd.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup mini marshmallows or whipped cream, for serving

steps.text: Whisk the cocoa powder with 1 cup of the milk in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker until no lumps remain.
Add the remaining milk, condensed milk, cream, chocolate chips and salt and stir well.
Cover and cook on LOW for 2 hours, whisking every 30 minutes, until the chocolate is melted and the cocoa is hot.
Whisk in the vanilla just before serving.
Switch the slow cooker to WARM to keep the cocoa hot for up to 2 hours, whisking occasionally.
Ladle into mugs and top with marshmallows or whipped cream.

recipes.photoCredit: || UggBoy♥UggGirl || PHOTO || WORLD || TRAVEL || / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:After_The_St._Patrick%27s_Parade_Late_Lunch_@_Lemon,_Dawson_Street,_Dublin,_Rep._Of_Ireland_A_Fine_Tradition!_(6992614913).jpg

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Jambalaya
recipes.description: A Creole jambalaya of chicken, andouille sausage, the holy trinity and spices, with shrimp and rice added near the end.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps.text: Place the chicken, sausage, onion, bell pepper, celery and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, broth, Creole seasoning, thyme, oregano, bay leaves and cayenne and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 to 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours.
Stir in the shrimp, cover, and cook on HIGH for 15 to 20 minutes until the shrimp are pink and opaque.
Remove the bay leaves and stir in the cooked rice, letting it absorb some of the liquid for 5 minutes.
Taste for seasoning, adding hot sauce if you like.
Serve sprinkled with green onions and parsley.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lasagna
recipes.description: Layers of meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella with uncooked noodles that cook right in the slow cooker.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or Italian sausage

steps.text: Brown the beef with the onion in a skillet over medium-high heat, then add the garlic, drain the fat, and stir in the marinara, crushed tomatoes, basil, oregano and salt.
Mix the ricotta, egg, Parmesan and parsley in a bowl.
Grease a 6-quart oval slow cooker and spread 1 cup of meat sauce over the bottom.
Layer 4 noodles on top, breaking them to fit, then spread with one third of the ricotta mixture, one third of the remaining sauce and 1 cup of mozzarella.
Repeat the layers twice more, making sure the top noodles are completely covered with sauce and ending with mozzarella.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours until the noodles are tender (avoid HIGH, which can scorch the edges).
Turn off the slow cooker, remove the lid and let the lasagna rest for 20 to 30 minutes so it firms up before slicing.

recipes.photoCredit: jules / stonesoup / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lasagne_-_stonesoup.jpg

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Macaroni and Cheese
recipes.description: Ultra-creamy mac and cheese that cooks right in the slow cooker with no boiling of the pasta.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack or Gruyère cheese

steps.text: Grease the insert of a 6-quart slow cooker with butter or cooking spray.
Add the uncooked macaroni and melted butter and stir to coat.
Stir in the evaporated milk, whole milk, salt, mustard, pepper and paprika.
Add the cream cheese and 3 cups of the shredded cheese and stir well.
Cover and cook on LOW for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, stirring every 30 to 45 minutes, until the pasta is tender (do not cook on HIGH, which can make it grainy).
Stir in the remaining cheese and a splash of milk if the sauce is too thick.
Let sit, covered, for 10 minutes on WARM and serve.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Minestrone
recipes.description: A hearty Italian vegetable soup with beans, tomatoes and pasta, full of garden vegetables.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 can (15 oz) cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 cup small pasta (ditalini or small shells)

steps.text: Place the onion, carrots, celery, garlic, zucchini and green beans in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the tomatoes, both beans, broth, Parmesan rind, Italian seasoning, bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the pasta, cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Remove the Parmesan rind and bay leaf and stir in the spinach until wilted.
Serve topped with grated Parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Mulled Apple Cider
recipes.description: Fragrant hot apple cider infused with orange, cinnamon and cloves that fills the house with the smell of fall.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown sugar or maple syrup (optional)
1 cup bourbon or spiced rum (optional, for adults)

steps.text: Pour the cider into a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the orange slices, cinnamon sticks, cloves, allspice, star anise and ginger (put the small spices in a tea ball or cheesecloth for easy removal).
Stir in the brown sugar if you like it sweeter.
Cover and cook on LOW for 3 to 4 hours or on HIGH for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until hot and fragrant.
Remove the spice bundle and switch to WARM to keep the cider hot for serving.
Ladle into mugs, adding a shot of bourbon or rum to individual cups if desired.

recipes.photoCredit: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cider_and_apple_juice.jpg

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Party Meatballs
recipes.description: Sweet and tangy cocktail meatballs in a grape jelly and chili sauce glaze — a guaranteed hit at any party.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 lb frozen fully cooked meatballs (about 64 small meatballs)

steps.text: Whisk together the grape jelly, chili sauce, Worcestershire, mustard and red pepper flakes in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the frozen meatballs and stir to coat them evenly in the sauce.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or on HIGH for 2 to 3 hours, stirring once or twice, until the meatballs are hot through.
Switch to the WARM setting for serving.
Serve from the slow cooker with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Carnitas
recipes.description: Citrus- and cumin-scented pork shoulder slow cooked until meltingly tender, then crisped under the broiler for tacos.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 4 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 3-inch chunks

steps.text: Mix the salt, pepper, cumin, oregano and chili powder and rub it all over the pork.
Place the onion, garlic and jalapeño in a 6-quart slow cooker and set the pork on top.
Pour the orange and lime juice over the pork and add the bay leaves.
Cover and cook on LOW for 9 to 10 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the pork falls apart.
Remove the pork, shred it with two forks, and toss it with about 1/2 cup of the strained cooking juices.
Spread the pork on a large rimmed baking sheet and broil 4 inches from the heat for 4 to 6 minutes until the edges are browned and crisp.
Drizzle with a little more of the juices and serve in warm tortillas with onion, cilantro, lime and salsa verde.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Chops
recipes.description: Slow cooking makes already-tender pork chops melt-in-your-mouth tender.
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 2 tbsp firmly packed dark brown sugar

steps.text: Brush chops with olive oil and season liberally with chop rub. Set aside.
Heat a large stainless steel or cast iron skillet over high heat. Add pork chops and cook until browned and slightly charred on both sides.
Remove and set aside.
Place pan back on heat and deglaze with white wine. Pour out wine and reserve.
Place apples in the bottom of a crockpot. Place pork chops on top and drizzle with remaining ingredients.
Cook on low 7–8 hours.
Drain apples and pork into a large saucepan. Bring liquid to a boil over high heat until reduced by half.
Pour liquid back over pork chops and serve warm.

recipes.notes: (Prep/cook times are estimates. Number of servings is an estimate.)
recipes.photoCredit: penny from Oakland, California, USA / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pork_chops_167541218.jpg

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
recipes.description: A classic Sunday pot roast with carrots and potatoes that cooks itself in the slow cooker until fork-tender.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb boneless beef chuck roast
1/2 cup dry red wine or more broth
2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water

steps.text: Pat the roast dry and season it all over with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the roast for 4 to 5 minutes per side until deeply browned.
Arrange the potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker and set the roast on top.
Whisk the broth, wine, tomato paste and Worcestershire in the hot skillet, scraping up the browned bits, and pour it over the roast.
Tuck in the thyme and rosemary, cover, and cook on LOW for 8 to 9 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the beef shreds easily.
Transfer the meat and vegetables to a platter and tent with foil.
Skim the fat from the cooking liquid and pour it into a saucepan, bring to a boil, and whisk in the cornstarch slurry until thickened.
Slice or shred the beef and serve with the vegetables and gravy.

recipes.photoCredit: Mark Miller / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:American_pot_roast.jpg

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
recipes.description: Smoky, spice-rubbed pork shoulder cooked low and slow, shredded and tossed with barbecue sauce for sandwiches.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Mix the brown sugar, paprika, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin and cayenne and rub it all over the pork.
Scatter the onion in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker and set the pork on top.
Pour the vinegar and broth around the pork.
Cover and cook on LOW for 10 to 12 hours or on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours until the pork falls apart easily.
Transfer the pork to a cutting board, discard any fat, and shred it with two forks.
Skim the fat from the liquid in the slow cooker, then return the pork and stir in 1 cup of barbecue sauce and about 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid.
Keep warm on the LOW or WARM setting and serve on buns with coleslaw and the remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Rice Pudding
recipes.description: Old-fashioned creamy rice pudding with cinnamon and raisins, cooked gently in the slow cooker.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice (not instant), rinsed

steps.text: Grease the insert of a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker with the butter.
Add the rice, milk, evaporated milk, sugar, salt and cinnamon stick and stir well.
Cover and cook on LOW for 3 to 4 hours or on HIGH for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, stirring every hour, until the rice is tender and creamy.
Stir in the raisins and vanilla during the last 30 minutes.
Remove the cinnamon stick; the pudding will thicken as it cools.
Serve warm or chilled, sprinkled with ground cinnamon.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Sausage Stuffing
recipes.description: Savory bread stuffing with sausage, celery, onion and herbs cooked in the slow cooker to save oven space on Thanksgiving.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 loaf (16 oz) day-old white or French bread, cut into 1-inch cubes and dried

steps.text: Brown the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, then transfer it to a very large bowl.
Melt the butter in the same skillet and cook the onions and celery for 8 to 10 minutes until soft.
Add the vegetables and butter to the bowl with the sausage, then add the bread cubes, parsley, sage, thyme, salt and pepper and toss well.
Whisk the eggs with 2 cups of broth and pour over the bread, tossing until evenly moistened, adding more broth if it seems dry.
Grease a 6-quart slow cooker and pile the stuffing in loosely.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or on HIGH for 2 hours until hot and set, removing the lid for the last 30 minutes to let the top dry slightly.
Keep warm on the WARM setting until serving.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Split Pea Soup with Ham
recipes.description: Thick, smoky split pea soup made with a meaty ham bone and vegetables, simmered all day.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 lb dried green split peas, rinsed
1 meaty ham bone or 2 smoked ham hocks
8 cups low-sodium chicken broth or water

steps.text: Place the split peas in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, garlic, bay leaves, thyme and pepper.
Nestle the ham bone in the center and add the diced ham.
Pour in the broth, cover, and cook on LOW for 8 to 10 hours or on HIGH for 4 to 5 hours until the peas have broken down.
Remove the ham bone and bay leaves, pull any meat from the bone, chop it and return it to the soup.
Stir vigorously or blend part of the soup for a smoother texture, adding water if it is too thick.
Season with salt to taste (the ham adds plenty) and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Swedish Meatballs
recipes.description: Tender homemade meatballs in a rich, creamy beef gravy with a hint of allspice, cooked hands-off in the slow cooker.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or heavy cream

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes in a large bowl.
Add the beef, pork, onion, egg, salt, pepper, allspice and nutmeg and mix gently until combined.
Roll into 1 1/2-inch meatballs and brown them in batches in a lightly oiled skillet, or bake them at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes.
Whisk the broth, Worcestershire, mustard and flour together until smooth and pour into a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the browned meatballs and gently stir to coat.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or on HIGH for 2 to 3 hours.
Stir in the sour cream and cook on LOW for 15 minutes more until heated through; do not let it boil.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve over egg noodles or mashed potatoes with lingonberry jam.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker White Chicken Chili
recipes.description: A creamy white chili with chicken, white beans and green chiles that practically makes itself.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.
ingredients: 2 cans (4 oz each) diced green chiles
3 cans (15 oz each) cannellini or great northern beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Place the chicken in a 6-quart slow cooker and top with the onion, garlic, green chiles and beans.
Sprinkle in the cumin, oregano, chili powder, salt and pepper and pour in the broth.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 to 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 to 4 hours until the chicken is tender.
Remove the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Mash about 1 cup of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the chili.
Return the chicken and stir in the cream cheese, sour cream and corn.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes more until the cheese melts and the corn is hot.
Serve topped with cilantro, avocado, Monterey Jack and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooked Chicken in Cream Sauce
recipes.author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
recipes.license: Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (en.wikibooks.org) by its contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted for this app.
ingredients: 1 can (10 ounces) condensed cream of chicken soup
1 can (10 ounces) condensed cream of celery soup

steps.text: Put chicken in crock pot.
Mix together cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup.
Pour soup mixture over chicken in crock pot.
Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.

recipes.notes: May substitute game birds. May substitute chicken breasts for the whole chicken parts. For camping, may cook in a Dutch oven or in a bean pot in a hole lined with coals and left all day. (Prep/cook times are estimates.)

recipes.title: Smashed Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy smashed cucumbers dressed with garlic, black vinegar, soy, and chili oil, a refreshing cold dish.
recipes.author: Recipe Box Kitchen
recipes.license: Original recipe written for Recipe Box. Free to share.

steps.text: Lay a cucumber on a cutting board and smash it firmly along its length with the flat side of a cleaver or a rolling pin until it cracks open.
